title.zh_hant: 海關青年實習計劃 150 職位吸逾 1,200 申請　今年擴展至四川
title.en: Customs youth internship programme draws over 1,200 applications for 150 places; expands to Sichuan this year
title.zh_hans: 海关青年实习计划 150 职位吸逾 1,200 申请　今年扩展至四川

summary.zh_hant: 香港海關今日在海關總部大樓舉行「香港海關青年發展計劃」（「Customs YES」）暑期工作實習計劃 2026 證書頒發典禮，向支持機構代表及「Customs YES」會員頒發感謝狀及實習證明書。海關關長陳子達致辭時表示，海關已連續六年舉辦暑期工作實習計劃，今年共提供 150 個本地及內地實習職位，吸引超過 1,200 份申請；感謝支持機構及導師，讓青年透過實踐認識職場、探索志向。今年計劃將內地實習網絡拓展至四川，並增加公共服務及慈善機構的實習機會，讓青年接觸不同產業及公共事務，加深對國家發展和社會需要的認識。陳子達勉勵青年珍惜機會、裝備自己，學有所成後發揮所長，回饋社會、貢獻國家和香港。海關表示，會繼續配合國家和特區政府的青年發展政策，透過「Customs YES」深化與各界合作，拓展實習及交流機會，培育具國家觀念、國際視野和社會承擔的新一代。
summary.en: Hong Kong Customs held the "Customs YES" Summer Internship Programme 2026 Certificate Presentation Ceremony at Customs Headquarters Building today, presenting certificates of appreciation and internship certificates to representatives of supporting organisations and "Customs YES" members. Commissioner of Customs and Excise Chan Tsz-tat said in his speech that Customs has organised the Summer Internship Programme for six consecutive years, offering 150 internship positions in Hong Kong and on the Mainland this year and attracting more than 1,200 applications. He thanked the supporting organisations and mentors for enabling young people to gain workplace experience and explore their aspirations. This year the programme expanded its Mainland internship network to Sichuan and offered more opportunities in public service and charitable organisations, exposing young people to different industries and public affairs and deepening their understanding of the country's development and community needs. Chan encouraged young people to make the most of the opportunities, equip themselves and apply their knowledge to serve society and contribute to the country and Hong Kong. Customs said it will continue to support the youth development policies of the country and the HKSAR Government, deepening collaboration through "Customs YES" to expand internship and exchange opportunities and nurture a new generation with a strong sense of national identity, a global perspective and commitment to society.
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关今日在海关总部大楼举行「香港海关青年发展计划」（「Customs YES」）暑期工作实习计划 2026 证书颁发典礼，向支持机构代表及「Customs YES」会员颁发感谢状及实习证明书。海关关长陈子达致辞时表示，海关已连续六年举办暑期工作实习计划，今年共提供 150 个本地及内地实习职位，吸引超过 1,200 份申请；感谢支持机构及导师，让青年透过实践认识职场、探索志向。今年计划将内地实习网络拓展至四川，并增加公共服务及慈善机构的实习机会，让青年接触不同产业及公共事务，加深对国家发展和社会需要的认识。陈子达勉励青年珍惜机会、装备自己，学有所成后发挥所长，回馈社会、贡献国家和香港。海关表示，会继续配合国家和特区政府的青年发展政策，透过「Customs YES」深化与各界合作，拓展实习及交流机会，培育具国家观念、国际视野和社会承担的新一代。

title.zh_hant: 機場截獲 5.5 公斤懷疑可卡因　市值 600 萬　48 歲內地男被捕
title.en: Airport officers seize about 5.5kg of suspected crack cocaine worth about $6 million; 48-year-old Mainland man arrested
title.zh_hans: 机场截获 5.5 公斤怀疑可卡因　市值 600 万　48 岁内地男被捕

summary.zh_hant: 香港海關今日在香港國際機場偵破一宗旅客販運毒品案件，檢獲約 5.5 公斤懷疑霹靂可卡因，估計市值約 600 萬元，並拘捕一名男子。一名 48 歲內地男旅客今日從菲律賓馬尼拉飛抵本港，海關人員清關時在其手提行李內發現該批懷疑霹靂可卡因，遂把該名男子拘捕，案件仍在調查中。海關表示，會繼續根據情報分析加強打擊販運毒品活動，提醒市民切勿貪圖金錢利益參與販毒，不要接受任何人士聘請或委託運送受管制物品進出香港，亦切勿在未確定物品屬性下貿然協助他人運送。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判罰款 500 萬元及終身監禁。
summary.en: Hong Kong Customs detected a drug trafficking case involving a passenger at Hong Kong International Airport today, seizing about 5.5 kilograms of suspected crack cocaine with an estimated market value of about $6 million and arresting a man. A 48-year-old Mainland male passenger arrived in Hong Kong from Manila, the Philippines, today, and Customs officers found the suspected crack cocaine in his carry-on baggage during clearance. The investigation is ongoing. Customs said it will continue to step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis, and reminded the public not to take part in drug trafficking for monetary gain, not to accept hiring or delegation to carry controlled items into or out of Hong Kong, and not to carry unknown items for others. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in a dangerous drug is a serious offence, punishable on conviction by a fine of up to $5 million and life imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关今日在香港国际机场侦破一宗旅客贩运毒品案件，检获约 5.5 公斤怀疑霹雳可卡因，估计市值约 600 万元，并拘捕一名男子。一名 48 岁内地男旅客今日从菲律宾马尼拉飞抵本港，海关人员清关时在其手提行李内发现该批怀疑霹雳可卡因，遂把该名男子拘捕，案件仍在调查中。海关表示，会继续根据情报分析加强打击贩运毒品活动，提醒市民切勿贪图金钱利益参与贩毒，不要接受任何人士聘请或委托运送受管制物品进出香港，亦切勿在未确定物品属性下贸然协助他人运送。根据《危险药物条例》，贩运危险药物属严重罪行，一经定罪最高可被判罚款 500 万元及终身监禁。

title.zh_hant: 孫中山誕辰 160 周年　逾 80 件肖像文物首度展出　明起免費入場
title.en: More than 80 artefacts of Sun Yat-sen's portraits go on display for the first time to mark 160th anniversary of his birth; free admission from tomorrow
title.zh_hans: 孙中山诞辰 160 周年　逾 80 件肖像文物首度展出　明起免费入场

summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署與香港浸會大學合作，於孫中山紀念館推出「日新萬象——孫中山形象的塑造與呈現」專題展覽。2026 年適逢孫中山先生誕辰 160 周年，孫中山紀念館首次以孫中山先生形象為策展主題，展出該館、香港浸會大學和本地私人珍藏的孫中山先生肖像文物逾 80 件（套）。展覽由明日（11 月 13 日）起至明年 7 月 7 日，免費入場。康文署助理署長（文博）伍志和在今日開幕典禮致辭時表示，孫中山先生一生以革命為己任，從立志救國、奮發向學，到組織革命、推翻帝制，奉獻一生振興中華；他提出的思想和方略為近代中國現代化奠定藍圖，成就對社會進步和人民福祉作出持久貢獻。展覽既展示鐫印其領袖形象並流通全國的錢幣和郵票，也有來自海內外的紀念郵品、鑄幣、塑像、漫畫等；亦以約 100 項歷史照片、報章剪報和檔案資料，配合多媒體展示，說明孫中山先生愛國且中西兼通的多重形象，如何在不同時期透過圖像、文字、實物以至公共空間塑造和呈現。為配合展覽，孫中山紀念館聯同浸大和香港公共圖書館推出一系列免費體驗活動，包括專題講座、公眾和學校展覽導賞及工作坊，並在六間公共圖書館舉行圖板展覽和親子工作坊。
summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department has collaborated with Hong Kong Baptist University to present the "Timeless Impressions — The Shaping and Representation of Dr Sun Yat-sen's Images" special exhibition at the Dr Sun Yat-sen Museum. The year 2026 marks the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen, and the museum is featuring Dr Sun's images as its curatorial theme for the first time, bringing together over 80 pieces (sets) of artefacts associated with Dr Sun's images from the museum, HKBU and local private collections. The exhibition runs from tomorrow (November 13) until July 7 next year, with free admission. Addressing the opening ceremony today, Assistant Director (Heritage and Museums) of Leisure and Cultural Services Ng Chi-wo said Dr Sun dedicated his entire life to the revolutionary cause — from resolving to save the nation and devoting himself to his studies, to organising the revolution and overthrowing the imperial system — and that the ideas and strategies he put forward laid the blueprint for the modernisation of China. The exhibition features coins and stamps bearing his image as a leader that circulated nationwide, along with commemorative philatelic items, coins, sculptures and cartoons from China and abroad, together with around 100 historical photographs, newspaper clippings and archival material, complemented by multimedia presentations, illustrating how Dr Sun's multifaceted image — patriotic yet well-versed in both Chinese and Western learning — was shaped and represented through pictures, texts, physical objects and public spaces in different periods. To tie in with the exhibition, the museum has collaborated with HKBU and Hong Kong Public Libraries to organise a series of free activities, including thematic lectures, guided tours and workshops for the public and schools, as well as panel exhibitions and parent-child workshops at six public libraries.
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署与香港浸会大学合作，于孙中山纪念馆推出「日新万象——孙中山形象的塑造与呈现」专题展览。2026 年适逢孙中山先生诞辰 160 周年，孙中山纪念馆首次以孙中山先生形象为策展主题，展出该馆、香港浸会大学和本地私人珍藏的孙中山先生肖像文物逾 80 件（套）。展览由明日（11 月 13 日）起至明年 7 月 7 日，免费入场。康文署助理署长（文博）伍志和在今日开幕典礼致辞时表示，孙中山先生一生以革命为己任，从立志救国、奋发向学，到组织革命、推翻帝制，奉献一生振兴中华；他提出的思想和方略为近代中国现代化奠定蓝图，成就对社会进步和人民福祉作出持久贡献。展览既展示镌印其领袖形象并流通全国的钱币和邮票，也有来自海内外的纪念邮品、铸币、塑像、漫画等；亦以约 100 项历史照片、报章剪报和档案资料，配合多媒体展示，说明孙中山先生爱国且中西兼通的多重形象，如何在不同时期透过图像、文字、实物以至公共空间塑造和呈现。为配合展览，孙中山纪念馆联同浸大和香港公共图书馆推出一系列免费体验活动，包括专题讲座、公众和学校展览导赏及工作坊，并在六间公共图书馆举行图板展览和亲子工作坊。

title.zh_hant: 全球交易公司IMC 13個月內兩度擴充香港業務　鞏固亞太區營運樞紐地位
title.en: Global trading firm IMC expands Hong Kong operations for second time in 13 months, cementing city as Asia-Pacific hub
title.zh_hans: 全球交易公司IMC 13个月内两度扩充香港业务　巩固亚太区营运枢纽地位

summary.zh_hant: 投資推廣署今日宣布，全球交易公司IMC 13個月內第二度擴充香港業務，辦公室面積擴大近三倍至近20,000平方呎，設於國際金融中心二期；團隊人數將增加一倍至逾100人，鞏固香港作為亞太區營運樞紐的地位，並以香港為系統化股票業務的亞太區樞紐。IMC以先進技術及研究為全球金融市場提供流通量，新辦公室將支援招聘量化研究員、軟件工程師及交易員。財政司司長許正宇在新辦公室開幕禮致辭時表示，香港會繼續推動金融市場高質量發展，正籌備現金市場T+1結算周期，並推進批發央行數碼貨幣用於收市後衍生工具交易。投資推廣署署長劉凱旋表示，香港的國際連通性、穩健法律制度及人才庫，為業務發展提供堅實基礎。IMC自1989年成立，全球員工逾2,000人，來自70個國籍，設有10個辦事處，連接全球超過120個交易場所。
summary.en: Invest Hong Kong announced today that leading global trading firm IMC has expanded its Hong Kong operations for the second time in 13 months, almost tripling its office space to nearly 20,000 square feet at Two International Finance Centre, and doubling its local team to more than 100 staff, cementing Hong Kong's position as its Asia-Pacific operating hub and the hub for its Asia-Pacific Systematic Equities business. IMC uses advanced technology and research to provide liquidity across global financial markets, and the new office will support recruitment of quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders. Speaking at the opening ceremony, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said Hong Kong will continue to promote the high-quality development of its financial market, with preparations under way for a T+1 settlement cycle for the cash market and for the use of wholesale central bank digital currency in after-hours derivatives trading. Director-General of Investment Promotion Alpha Lau said Hong Kong's international connectivity, robust legal system and talent pool provide strong foundations for business success. Founded in 1989, IMC has more than 2,000 employees from over 70 nationalities across 10 offices, quoting continuously on more than 120 trading venues worldwide.
summary.zh_hans: 投资推广署今日宣布，全球交易公司IMC 13个月内第二度扩充香港业务，办公室面积扩大近三倍至近20,000平方呎，设于国际金融中心二期；团队人数将增加一倍至逾100人，巩固香港作为亚太区营运枢纽的地位，并以香港为系统化股票业务的亚太区枢纽。IMC以先进技术及研究为全球金融市场提供流通量，新办公室将支援招聘量化研究员、软件工程师及交易员。财政司司长许正宇在新办公室开幕礼致辞时表示，香港会继续推动金融市场高质量发展，正筹备现金市场T+1结算周期，并推进批发央行数码货币用于收市后衍生工具交易。投资推广署署长刘凯旋表示，香港的国际连通性、稳健法律制度及人才库，为业务发展提供坚实基础。IMC自1989年成立，全球员工逾2,000人，来自70个国籍，设有10个办事处，连接全球超过120个交易场所。

title.zh_hant: 駐迪拜經貿辦慶祝成立五周年　持續深化香港與中東夥伴合作關係
title.en: Dubai ETO marks fifth anniversary, deepening Hong Kong-Middle East partnerships
title.zh_hans: 驻迪拜经贸办庆祝成立五周年　持续深化香港与中东伙伴合作关系

summary.zh_hant: 駐迪拜經濟貿易辦事處於迪拜時間11月9日在迪拜舉行成立五周年晚宴，逾350名嘉賓出席，慶祝香港與中東夥伴關係持續深化。駐迪拜經貿辦處長陳尚文表示，經貿辦是特區政府在中東地區首個經貿辦，覆蓋阿聯酋及海灣阿拉伯國家合作委員會成員國，致力促進兩地經貿及文化聯繫；過去五年香港與阿聯酋雙邊貿易平均每年增長8.2%，阿聯酋是香港在中東最大的貿易夥伴，香港亦是阿聯酋非石油出口增長最快的市場之一。文化交流方面，阿聯酋參與香港書展及青年交流，經貿辦連續五年在阿聯酋舉辦香港電影節，今年迪拜河龍舟挑戰賽吸引62支隊伍參賽。晚宴亦安排人形機械人同步群舞表演，以及香港中東音樂組合The Saffron演出。經貿辦於2021年10月開始運作。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Dubai hosted a gala dinner in Dubai on November 9 (Dubai time) to celebrate the fifth anniversary of its establishment, with more than 350 guests attending to mark the deepening partnership between Hong Kong and the Middle East. Director-General of the Dubai ETO Simon Chan said the office is the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government's first ETO in the Middle East, covering the United Arab Emirates and member states of the Gulf Co-operation Council and dedicated to fostering economic, trade and cultural ties between the two regions. Over the past five years, bilateral trade between Hong Kong and the UAE has grown by an average of 8.2 per cent a year; the UAE is Hong Kong's largest trading partner in the Middle East, and Hong Kong is one of the fastest-growing markets for the UAE's non-oil exports. On cultural exchanges, the UAE has taken part in the Hong Kong Book Fair and youth exchanges, the ETO has hosted a Hong Kong film festival in the UAE for five consecutive years, and this year's Dubai Creek dragon boat challenge attracted 62 teams. The dinner also featured a synchronised dance by humanoid robots and a performance by The Saffron, a Hong Kong-based Middle Eastern music ensemble. The ETO commenced operations in October 2021.
summary.zh_hans: 驻迪拜经济贸易办事处于迪拜时间11月9日在迪拜举行成立五周年晚宴，逾350名嘉宾出席，庆祝香港与中东伙伴关系持续深化。驻迪拜经贸办处长陈尚文表示，经贸办是特区政府在中东地区首个经贸办，覆盖阿联酋及海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会成员国，致力促进两地经贸及文化联系；过去五年香港与阿联酋双边贸易平均每年增长8.2%，阿联酋是香港在中东最大的贸易伙伴，香港亦是阿联酋非石油出口增长最快的市场之一。文化交流方面，阿联酋参与香港书展及青年交流，经贸办连续五年在阿联酋举办香港电影节，今年迪拜河龙舟挑战赛吸引62支队伍参赛。晚宴亦安排人形机械人同步群舞表演，以及香港中东音乐组合The Saffron演出。经贸办于2021年10月开始运作。

title.zh_hant: 入境處遣返20名越南非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士
title.en: Immigration Department repatriates 20 Vietnamese illegal immigrants and one overstayer
title.zh_hans: 入境处遣返20名越南非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士

summary.zh_hant: 入境處今日進行遣返行動，將20名越南非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士遣返越南。被遣返人士包括14男7女，全部是未經證實的免遣返聲請人，當中包括曾干犯刑事罪行並被判監的已出獄人士。入境處表示會繼續致力盡快遣返未經證實的免遣返聲請人，以維持有效的入境管制及保障公眾利益；根據2022年12月7日起生效的更新遣返政策，高等法院原訟法庭駁回司法覆核案件的聲請人一般可隨即遣返，提升遣返效率。入境處會繼續探討可行方案加快遣返程序，並與主要來源國政府、航空公司及其他部門保持聯繫。
summary.en: The Immigration Department today carried out a repatriation operation, removing 20 Vietnamese illegal immigrants and one overstayer to Vietnam. The group comprised 14 men and seven women, all unsubstantiated non-refoulement claimants, including discharged prisoners who had committed criminal offences and served prison sentences. The department said it remains committed to promptly removing unsubstantiated claimants to maintain effective immigration control and safeguard the public interest; under the updated removal policy effective from December 7, 2022, a claimant whose judicial review case has been dismissed by the Court of First Instance can generally be removed right away, improving removal efficiency. The department will keep exploring feasible ways to speed up repatriations and liaise with the governments of major source countries, airlines and other departments.
summary.zh_hans: 入境处今日进行遣返行动，将20名越南非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士遣返越南。被遣返人士包括14男7女，全部是未经证实的免遣返声请人，当中包括曾干犯刑事罪行并被判监的已出狱人士。入境处表示会继续致力尽快遣返未经证实的免遣返声请人，以维持有效的入境管制及保障公众利益；根据2022年12月7日起生效的更新遣返政策，高等法院原讼法庭驳回司法覆核案件的声请人一般可随即遣返，提升遣返效率。入境处会继续探讨可行方案加快遣返程序，并与主要来源国政府、航空公司及其他部门保持联系。

title.zh_hant: 精準扶貧委員會開第二次會議　探訪荃灣西社區客廳
title.en: Commission on Targeted Poverty Alleviation holds second meeting and visits Tsuen Wan West Community Living Room
title.zh_hans: 精准扶贫委员会开第二次会议　探访荃湾西社区客厅

summary.zh_hant: 政務司司長陳國基今日下午主持第七屆精準扶貧委員會第二次會議，並率領委員探訪荃灣西社區客廳。荃灣西社區客廳今年6月啟用，是新界首個社區客廳，由政府牽頭、邵氏基金會提供場地、關愛基金資助營運開支、香港基督教女青年會負責營運，截至今年8月31日已錄得逾12萬人次。陳國基在會上表示，首份《香港經濟社會發展五年規劃》（2026-2030）及今年《施政報告》均堅持以人民為中心，提出加強精準扶貧及增設社區客廳；現時全港社區客廳增至18間，預計服務約一萬個劏房家庭，年底前會有新社區客廳啟用。委員會已將照顧者納入精準扶貧對象，荃灣西社區客廳亦為照顧特殊需要兒童的家庭提供針對性支援服務。
summary.en: Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki chaired the second meeting of the seventh-term Commission on Targeted Poverty Alleviation this afternoon and led members on a visit to the Tsuen Wan West Community Living Room. The Tsuen Wan West Community Living Room opened in June this year as the first such facility in the New Territories; spearheaded by the Government, with the venue provided by the Shaw Foundation, operating expenses funded by the Community Care Fund and operations run by the Hong Kong Young Women's Christian Association, it had recorded over 120,000 attendances as of August 31. Chan said at the meeting that the first Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of Hong Kong (2026-2030) and this year's Policy Address both uphold people-oriented governance, proposing to step up targeted poverty alleviation and add more Community Living Rooms; the total across Hong Kong has now risen to 18, expected to serve about 10,000 subdivided-unit families, with more opening before year-end. The Commission has included carers among its targeted groups, and the Tsuen Wan West facility provides targeted support for families caring for children with special needs.
summary.zh_hans: 政务司司长陈国基今日下午主持第七届精准扶贫委员会第二次会议，并率领委员探访荃湾西社区客厅。荃湾西社区客厅今年6月启用，是新界首个社区客厅，由政府牵头、邵氏基金会提供场地、关爱基金资助营运开支、香港基督教女青年会负责营运，截至今年8月31日已录得逾12万人次。陈国基在会上表示，首份《香港经济社会发展五年规划》（2026-2030）及今年《施政报告》均坚持以人民为中心，提出加强精准扶贫及增设社区客厅；现时全港社区客厅增至18间，预计服务约一万个劏房家庭，年底前会有新社区客厅启用。委员会已将照顾者纳入精准扶贫对象，荃湾西社区客厅亦为照顾特殊需要儿童的家庭提供针对性支援服务。

title.zh_hant: 食環署與海關巡查50個大閘蟹銷售處所　未發現違規
title.en: FEHD and Customs inspect 50 hairy crab outlets; no irregularities found
title.zh_hans: 食环署与海关巡查50个大闸蟹销售处所　未发现违规

summary.zh_hant: 食環署與海關自11月9日起展開聯合突擊行動，巡查各區大閘蟹銷售點，確保市面出售的大閘蟹符合法例要求。食安中心、食環署環境衞生部及海關人員共巡查50個大閘蟹銷售處所，檢查大閘蟹的來源文件及衞生證明書，確保符合《公眾衞生及市政條例》及《商品說明條例》，適合供人食用；行動期間未發現違規情況，人員亦向商戶派發宣傳單張，提醒注意食物安全。食環署提醒市民應光顧持有介貝類水產動物（大閘蟹）售賣許可證或相關書面准許的商戶，如懷疑商戶無牌經營，可致電食環署熱線2868 0000舉報。
summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and Hong Kong Customs have conducted joint blitz operations since November 9 to inspect hairy crab selling points across various districts, ensuring crabs on sale comply with the law. Officers from the Centre for Food Safety, the Environmental Hygiene Branch and Customs inspected 50 premises selling hairy crabs, checking source documents and health certificates to confirm compliance with the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance and the Trade Descriptions Ordinance and that the crabs are fit for human consumption; no contraventions were found, and officers distributed promotional leaflets reminding operators about food safety. The FEHD reminded the public to buy from reputable shops holding a Shell Fish (Hairy Crab) Permit or relevant written permission, and to report suspected unlicensed operators via the FEHD hotline 2868 0000.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署与海关自11月9日起展开联合突击行动，巡查各区大闸蟹销售点，确保市面出售的大闸蟹符合法例要求。食安中心、食环署环境卫生部及海关人员共巡查50个大闸蟹销售处所，检查大闸蟹的来源文件及卫生证明书，确保符合《公众卫生及市政条例》及《商品说明条例》，适合供人食用；行动期间未发现违规情况，人员亦向商户派发宣传单张，提醒注意食物安全。食环署提醒市民应光顾持有介贝类水产动物（大闸蟹）售卖许可证或相关书面准许的商户，如怀疑商户无牌经营，可致电食环署热线2868 0000举报。

title.zh_hant: 金管局證監會合辦研討會　推動代幣化及Ensemble項目合作
title.en: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar to advance tokenisation and Project Ensemble collaboration
title.zh_hans: 金管局证监会合办研讨会　推动代币化及Ensemble项目合作

summary.zh_hant: 金管局與證監會昨日合辦研討會，聚焦Ensemble項目及代幣化證監會認可投資產品，銀行及業界先行者分享代幣化實踐經驗，以促進合作及推動香港代幣化生態圈發展。研討會緊接金管局在香港金融科技周2026宣布EnsembleTX新篇章，可實現代幣化存款24小時跨行結算；證監會亦批准代幣化貨幣市場基金全天候二級市場交易，讓投資者實時優化投資及回報。金管局金融基建部執行董事周文正表示，香港憑藉先進金融市場基建及日益多元的數碼貨幣選擇及代幣化投資產品，正好把握代幣化時代機遇；證監會投資產品部執行董事伍潔鏹表示，香港代幣化正由試驗走向商業化，下一階段要將代幣化投資產品、數碼貨幣及金融基建連接起來。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Securities and Futures Commission co-hosted a seminar yesterday focusing on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products, where banks and industry pioneers shared practical tokenisation experience to foster collaboration and advance Hong Kong's tokenisation ecosystem. The seminar followed the HKMA's announcement during Hong Kong Fintech Week 2026 of a new chapter of EnsembleTX, enabling 24-hour interbank settlement of tokenised deposits, while the SFC has approved round-the-clock secondary trading for tokenised money market funds, allowing investors to optimise investments and returns in real time. Nelson Chow, the HKMA's Executive Director (Financial Infrastructure), said Hong Kong is well positioned to capitalise on the tokenisation era with its advanced financial market infrastructure and expanding range of digital money options and tokenised investment products; Elisa Ng, the SFC's Executive Director (Investment Products), said tokenisation in Hong Kong is moving from experimentation towards commercialisation, and the next stage is to connect tokenised investment products, digital money and financial infrastructure.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局与证监会昨日合办研讨会，聚焦Ensemble项目及代币化证监会认可投资产品，银行及业界先行者分享代币化实践经验，以促进合作及推动香港代币化生态圈发展。研讨会紧接金管局在香港金融科技周2026宣布EnsembleTX新篇章，可实现代币化存款24小时跨行结算；证监会亦批准代币化货币市场基金全天候二级市场交易，让投资者实时优化投资及回报。金管局金融基建部执行董事周文正表示，香港凭借先进金融市场基建及日益多元的数码货币选择及代币化投资产品，正好把握代币化时代机遇；证监会投资产品部执行董事伍洁镪表示，香港代币化正由试验走向商业化，下一阶段要将代币化投资产品、数码货币及金融基建连接起来。

title.zh_hant: 海關破獲遠洋船走私瀕危物種案　檢獲貨物市值約1億元
title.en: Customs busts ocean-going vessel smuggling case; suspected endangered species worth about HK$100 million seized
title.zh_hans: 海关破获远洋船走私濒危物种案　检获货物市值约1亿元

summary.zh_hant: 海關10月24日檢查4個原定運往韓國、報稱載有海鮮的貨櫃，經查驗後檢獲大批懷疑走私瀕危物種貨物，包括受管制鯊魚翅、鯊魚皮、鱷魚皮、海馬、蝠鱝鰓板以及海參，估計市值共約1億元。海關說，案件仍在調查中，不排除會有人被捕。海關表示，走私受管制瀕危物種屬嚴重罪行，根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，任何人違反條例進口、出口或管有瀕危物種標本，一經定罪最高可罰款1,000萬元及監禁10年；海關會繼續透過主動風險管理及情報主導執法策略，堅決打擊海上走私活動。
summary.en: Hong Kong Customs inspected four containers on October 24 that were scheduled to be shipped to Korea and declared as carrying seafood, seizing large batches of suspected smuggled endangered species goods including scheduled shark fins, shark skins, crocodile skins, sea dragons, mobula gill plates and sea cucumbers, with an estimated total market value of about HK$100 million. Customs said investigations are ongoing and arrests are not ruled out. Smuggling scheduled endangered species is a serious offence; under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, anyone importing, exporting or possessing specimens in breach of the ordinance faces a maximum fine of HK$10 million and 10 years' imprisonment on conviction, and Customs will continue to combat sea smuggling through proactive risk management and intelligence-led enforcement.
summary.zh_hans: 海关10月24日检查4个原定运往韩国、报称载有海鲜的货柜，经查验后检获大批怀疑走私濒危物种货物，包括受管制鲨鱼翅、鲨鱼皮、鳄鱼皮、海马、蝠鲼鳃板以及海参，估计市值共约1亿元。海关说，案件仍在调查中，不排除会有人被捕。海关表示，走私受管制濒危物种属严重罪行，根据《保护濒危动植物物种条例》，任何人违反条例进口、出口或管有濒危物种标本，一经定罪最高可罚款1,000万元及监禁10年；海关会继续透过主动风险管理及情报主导执法策略，坚决打击海上走私活动。

title.zh_hant: 入境男旅客攜3萬支未完稅香煙　判監6個月罰款1000元
title.en: Incoming male passenger jailed for six months over 30,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes
title.zh_hans: 入境男旅客携3万支未完税香烟　判监6个月罚款1000元

summary.zh_hant: 一名29歲內地男旅客9月16日由日本東京抵港，海關在其個人行李檢獲3萬支未完稅香煙，估計市值約12.3萬元，應課稅款約9.9萬元。該名旅客今日在西九龍裁判法院被判監禁6個月及罰款1,000元，罪名是進口未完稅香煙及未向海關申報。海關表示，判刑具相當阻嚇作用，反映罪行嚴重性，並提醒市民香煙屬應課稅品，進口、管有或買賣未完稅香煙均屬違法，最高可罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
summary.en: A 29-year-old mainland male passenger who arrived in Hong Kong from Tokyo on September 16 was found with 30,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes in his personal baggage, with an estimated market value of about HK$123,000 and a duty potential of about HK$99,000. He was sentenced by the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday to six months' imprisonment and fined HK$1,000 for importing duty-not-paid cigarettes and failing to declare them to Customs officers. Customs said the custodial sentence has a considerable deterrent effect and reflects the seriousness of the offences, reminding the public that cigarettes are dutiable goods and that importing, possessing or buying duty-not-paid cigarettes is an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 一名29岁内地男旅客9月16日由日本东京抵港，海关在其个人行李检获3万支未完税香烟，估计市值约12.3万元，应课税款约9.9万元。该名旅客今日在西九龙裁判法院被判监禁6个月及罚款1,000元，罪名是进口未完税香烟及未向海关申报。海关表示，判刑具相当阻吓作用，反映罪行严重性，并提醒市民香烟属应课税品，进口、管有或买卖未完税香烟均属违法，最高可罚款200万元及监禁7年。

title.zh_hant: Nvidia 震撼換帥！黃仁勳即日起辭任行政總裁　財務總監暫代掌舵
title.en: Nvidia chief Jensen Huang resigns as CEO with immediate effect; CFO to serve as interim chief
title.zh_hans: Nvidia 震撼换帅！黄仁勋即日起辞任行政总裁　财务总监暂代掌舵

summary.zh_hant: Nvidia 董事會宣布，黃仁勳辭去行政總裁及董事職務，即日起生效，董事會已啟動行政總裁遴選工作，將考慮內部及外部人選。集團指，在確定正式繼任人之前，現任執行副總裁、財務總監 Colette Kress 將出任臨時行政總裁，並任命 Harvey C. Jones 為董事會首位主席。聲明感謝黃仁勳過去 33 年對集團作出的貢獻，強調 Nvidia 是全球最具影響力的科技公司之一，預計公司營運、對客戶的承諾及產品路線圖將繼續順利推進。Kress 自 2013 年 9 月加入集團領導財務團隊，加入前曾在思科及微軟擔任財務職位近 25 年；Jones 則有逾 30 年企業家、科技主管及創投經驗，曾任新思科技執行主席兼行政總裁。
summary.en: Nvidia's board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive and director with immediate effect, and the board has begun the search for a new chief executive, considering internal and external candidates. Until a permanent successor is named, executive vice-president and chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim chief executive, and Harvey C. Jones has been appointed as the board's first chairman. In a statement, the company thanked Huang for his contributions over the past 33 years and stressed that Nvidia is one of the world's most influential technology companies, adding that operations, commitments to customers and the product roadmap are expected to continue smoothly. Kress joined the group in September 2013 to lead its finance team, having previously spent nearly 25 years in finance roles at Cisco and Microsoft; Jones has more than 30 years of experience as an entrepreneur, technology executive and venture capitalist, and was executive chairman and chief executive of Synopsys.
summary.zh_hans: Nvidia 董事会宣布，黄仁勋辞去行政总裁及董事职务，即日起生效，董事会已启动行政总裁遴选工作，将考虑内部及外部人选。集团指，在确定正式继任人之前，现任执行副总裁、财务总监 Colette Kress 将出任临时行政总裁，并任命 Harvey C. Jones 为董事会首位主席。声明感谢黄仁勋过去 33 年对集团作出的贡献，强调 Nvidia 是全球最具影响力的科技公司之一，预计公司营运、对客户的承诺及产品路线图将继续顺利推进。Kress 自 2013 年 9 月加入集团领导财务团队，加入前曾在思科及微软担任财务职位近 25 年；Jones 则有逾 30 年企业家、科技主管及创投经验，曾任新思科技执行主席兼行政总裁。

title.zh_hant: 美國上周新申領失業救濟增至 20 萬人　多於預期
title.en: US weekly initial jobless claims rise to 200,000, above expectations
title.zh_hans: 美国上周新申领失业救济增至 20 万人　多于预期

summary.zh_hant: 美國上星期新申領失業救濟人數增至 20 萬人，多於預期，按星期增加 9,000 人，近兩個月只有兩星期達到 20 萬人水平。4 星期平均值維持於逾 19.5 萬人。截至 10 月 31 日止的一星期，持續申領失業救濟人數減至 169.7 萬人，按星期減少 2 萬人。
summary.en: US initial jobless claims rose to 200,000 last week, above expectations, up 9,000 from the previous week; only two weeks in the past two months have reached the 200,000 level. The four-week moving average held at just over 195,000. Continuing claims for the week ended October 31 fell to 1.697 million, down 20,000 from the previous week.
summary.zh_hans: 美国上星期新申领失业救济人数增至 20 万人，多于预期，按星期增加 9,000 人，近两个月只有两星期达到 20 万人水平。4 星期平均值维持于逾 19.5 万人。截至 10 月 31 日止的一星期，持续申领失业救济人数减至 169.7 万人，按星期减少 2 万人。

title.zh_hant: 周生生系統遭未經授權存取　部分客戶及員工資料或曾被提取
title.en: Chow Sang Sang says systems hit by unauthorised access; some customer and staff data may have been extracted
title.zh_hans: 周生生系统遭未经授权存取　部分客户及员工资料或曾被提取

summary.zh_hant: 周生生發出公告指，近日發現系統遭受未經授權存取，本周一首次識別有關事件，部分客戶及員工資料可能曾被提取，仍有待進一步核實。初步調查顯示，受影響系統包括會員系統及官方電子商貿渠道。集團已著手採取措施遏止所有未經授權存取行為、加強系統安全性，並委聘網絡安全專家展開調查及就適當措施提供建議。調查仍在進行中，集團已通報相關機構，包括香港個人資料私隱專員公署及警方，並正向可能受影響客戶及員工發出通知，將繼續密切監察事態發展、配合相關機構調查，以及採取適當措施全面調查事件、作出補救及減低潛在影響。
summary.en: Chow Sang Sang said in an announcement that it recently discovered unauthorised access to its systems, first identified on Monday, and that some customer and staff data may have been extracted, pending further verification. Preliminary investigations show the affected systems include the membership system and the official e-commerce channels. The group has taken steps to stop all unauthorised access, strengthen system security, and engaged cybersecurity experts to investigate and advise on appropriate measures. The investigation is ongoing; the group has notified the relevant authorities, including the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data and the police, and is notifying potentially affected customers and staff. It will continue to monitor developments closely, co-operate with the authorities' investigations and take appropriate steps to investigate, remedy and mitigate the potential impact.
summary.zh_hans: 周生生发出公告指，近日发现系统遭受未经授权存取，本周一首次识别有关事件，部分客户及员工资料可能曾被提取，仍有待进一步核实。初步调查显示，受影响系统包括会员系统及官方电商渠道。集团已着手采取措施遏止所有未经授权存取行为、加强系统安全性，并委聘网络安全专家展开调查及就适当措施提供建议。调查仍在进行中，集团已通报相关机构，包括香港个人资料私隐专员公署及警方，并正向可能受影响客户及员工发出通知，将继续密切监察事态发展、配合相关机构调查，以及采取适当措施全面调查事件、作出补救及减低潜在影响。

title.zh_hant: 崇光百貨會員系統遭入侵　82 萬會員資料或受影響
title.en: Sogo membership system breached; personal data of about 820,000 members may be affected
title.zh_hans: 崇光百货会员系统遭入侵　82 万会员资料或受影响

summary.zh_hant: 崇光（香港）百貨有限公司表示，本月發現會員系統曾遭未經授權人士取得部分資料，受影響資料主要涉及部分會員號碼、姓名、聯絡電話、電郵及會員積分資料。崇光百貨表示高度重視事件，已立即展開全面調查及跟進工作，已向相關政府部門通報，並正全力配合調查。崇光百貨對事件可能為會員帶來的不便深表歉意，已即時採取多項應變措施，包括提升網絡安全系統監察、異常活動偵測、進行詳細調查及風險評估，以及持續監察系統運作情況，以防止同類事件再次發生。個人資料私隱專員公署表示，今日接獲相關通報，事故可能影響約 82 萬名會員的個人資料，公署已根據既定機制就事故展開調查。
summary.en: Sogo (Hong Kong) Department Store said it discovered this month that unauthorised persons had obtained some data from its membership system, mainly involving some membership numbers, names, contact numbers, email addresses and membership points records. Sogo said it attaches great importance to the incident, has immediately launched a full investigation and follow-up, has notified the relevant government departments and is fully co-operating with the investigation. It apologised for any inconvenience to members and has taken a number of immediate measures, including stepping up cybersecurity monitoring and abnormal activity detection, conducting a detailed investigation and risk assessment, and continuously monitoring system operations to prevent a recurrence. The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said it received the relevant notification today and that the incident may affect the personal data of about 820,000 members; it has launched an investigation under its established mechanism.
summary.zh_hans: 崇光（香港）百货有限公司表示，本月发现会员系统曾遭未经授权人士取得部分资料，受影响资料主要涉及部分会员号码、姓名、联络电话、电邮及会员积分资料。崇光百货表示高度重视事件，已立即展开全面调查及跟进工作，已向相关政府部门通报，并正全力配合调查。崇光百货对事件可能为会员带来的不便深表歉意，已即时采取多项应变措施，包括提升网络安全系统监察、异常活动侦测、进行详细调查及风险评估，以及持续监察系统运作情况，以防止同类事件再次发生。个人资料私隐专员公署表示，今日接获相关通报，事故可能影响约 82 万名会员的个人资料，公署已根据既定机制就事故展开调查。

title.zh_hant: 普京晤美特使放話：外國軍隊駐烏克蘭　即成俄軍合法打擊目標
title.en: Putin tells US envoys foreign troops stationed in Ukraine would be legitimate targets for Russian strikes
title.zh_hans: 普京晤美特使放话：外国军队驻乌克兰　即成俄军合法打击目标

summary.zh_hant: 為期兩日的俄羅斯、美國、烏克蘭三方會談在阿聯酋首都阿布扎比結束後，俄羅斯總統普京星期四在莫斯科會見美國總統特使威特科夫及總統特朗普的女婿庫什納。普京請兩人向特朗普轉達謝意，感謝美方為促成俄烏雙方接觸所作的努力。他說，俄羅斯不能接受外國軍隊在烏克蘭駐紮，認為將對俄羅斯國家安全構成威脅，強調部署在烏克蘭境內的外國軍隊將成為俄軍的合法打擊目標。他又說，俄羅斯從未關閉與歐洲對話的大門，是歐洲方面主動中斷對話；特朗普曾提議就建立歐洲新的安全體系達成協議，但布魯塞爾方面拒絕。
summary.en: After the two-day Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, Russian President Vladimir Putin met US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner in Moscow on Thursday. Putin asked them to convey his thanks to Trump for US efforts to bring Russia and Ukraine into contact. He said Russia cannot accept foreign troops being stationed in Ukraine, which he said would threaten Russia's national security, and stressed that foreign troops deployed in Ukraine would become legitimate targets for Russian strikes. He added that Russia has never closed the door to dialogue with Europe, and that it was Europe that took the initiative to cut off dialogue; Trump had proposed an agreement on a new European security architecture, but Brussels rejected it.
summary.zh_hans: 为期两日的俄罗斯、美国、乌克兰三方会谈在阿联酋首都阿布扎比结束后，俄罗斯总统普京星期四在莫斯科会见美国总统特使威特科夫及总统特朗普的女婿库什纳。普京请两人向特朗普转达谢意，感谢美方为促成俄乌双方接触所作的努力。他说，俄罗斯不能接受外国军队在乌克兰驻扎，认为将对俄罗斯国家安全构成威胁，强调部署在乌克兰境内的外国军队将成为俄军的合法打击目标。他又说，俄罗斯从未关闭与欧洲对话的大门，是欧洲方面主动中断对话；特朗普曾提议就建立欧洲新的安全体系达成协议，但布鲁塞尔方面拒绝。

title.zh_hant: 菲律賓多個政府部門遭網絡攻擊　數百萬條個人企業資料外洩
title.en: Philippine authorities say multiple government departments hit by cyberattacks with large amounts of personal and corporate data leaked
title.zh_hans: 菲律宾多个政府部门遭网络攻击　数百万条个人企业资料外泄

summary.zh_hant: 菲律賓國家隱私委員會表示，確認近期收到多個政府部門遭遇網絡攻擊並發生數據洩露的報告，大量企業和個人隱私數據遭洩露。當局說，洩露的數據涉及菲律賓信息和通訊技術部、證券交易委員會、稅務局、司法部、勞工和就業部、海岸警衛隊等政府部門，提醒公眾保持警惕，防範不法分子可能利用公眾對數據洩露的擔憂進行網絡釣魚、詐騙、身份盜竊等。有當地網絡安全組織估計，近期的政府部門數據洩露事件涉及數百萬條個人、企業和行政記錄。
summary.en: The National Privacy Commission of the Philippines said it has confirmed recent reports of cyberattacks and data breaches at multiple government departments, with large amounts of corporate and personal private data leaked. The leaked data involves the Department of Information and Communications Technology, the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Bureau of Internal Revenue, the Department of Justice, the Department of Labor and Employment and the Coast Guard, among others. The authorities urged the public to stay alert against phishing, fraud and identity theft by criminals exploiting concerns over the breaches. A local cybersecurity organisation estimates the recent government data breaches involve millions of personal, corporate and administrative records.
summary.zh_hans: 菲律宾国家隐私委员会表示，确认近期收到多个政府部门遭遇网络攻击并发生数据泄露的报告，大量企业和个人隐私数据遭泄露。当局说，泄露的数据涉及菲律宾信息和通讯技术部、证券交易委员会、税务局、司法部、劳工和就业部、海岸警卫队等政府部门，提醒公众保持警惕，防范不法分子可能利用公众对数据泄露的担忧进行网络钓鱼、诈骗、身份盗窃等。有当地网络安全组织估计，近期的政府部门数据泄露事件涉及数百万条个人、企业和行政记录。

title.zh_hant: 京東 13.35 億歐元完成收購 CECONOMY　合共持股 85.2% 進軍歐洲市場
title.en: JD.com completes €1.335 billion acquisition of CECONOMY, taking combined stake to 85.2%
title.zh_hans: 京东 13.35 亿欧元完成收购 CECONOMY　合共持股 85.2% 进军欧洲市场

summary.zh_hant: 京東集團發出公告指，完成以 13.35 億歐元收購 CECONOMY 的 59.8% 股本及投票權，收購按每股 4.6 歐元現金作出。連同京東集團合作夥伴 Convergenta 保留的 25.3% 股權，今次收購令雙方對 CECONOMY 的持股比例合共達 85.2%。公告指，今次已完成所有要約條件，包括取得經營者集中審批、外商投資審批及歐盟外國補貼審批。京東集團表示，CECONOMY 將在歐洲保持獨立營運，擁有當地獨立技術架構，無計劃調整人員、員工協議及辦公地點；對方將成為京東集團子公司，今日起納入集團合併財務報表。京東集團首席執行官許冉表示，雙方有共同願景，打造歐洲領先的新一代消費電子產品平台，合作夥伴關係將支持歐洲更廣泛的創新及競爭力目標，有助打造更具活力的歐洲消費零售市場。CECONOMY 以 MediaMarkt、Saturn 及 MediaWorld 品牌，在 11 個市場經營逾 1,000 家消費電子產品店，同時經營線上零售業務，有逾 5 萬名員工。
summary.en: JD.com said in an announcement that it has completed the acquisition of a 59.8 per cent stake in CECONOMY for €1.335 billion, at €4.60 per share in cash. Together with the 25.3 per cent stake retained by JD.com's partner Convergenta, the acquisition takes the two parties' combined holding in CECONOMY to 85.2 per cent. The announcement said all offer conditions have been fulfilled, including merger control, foreign investment and EU foreign subsidy approvals. JD.com said CECONOMY will continue to operate independently in Europe with its own local technology architecture, with no plans to change personnel, staff agreements or office locations; it will become a JD.com subsidiary and be consolidated into the group's financial statements from today. JD.com chief executive Sandy Ran Xu said the two sides share a vision of building Europe's leading next-generation consumer electronics platform, and the partnership will support broader innovation and competitiveness goals in Europe and help create a more dynamic European consumer retail market. CECONOMY operates more than 1,000 consumer electronics stores in 11 markets under the MediaMarkt, Saturn and MediaWorld brands, alongside online retail, with more than 50,000 employees.
summary.zh_hans: 京东集团发出公告指，完成以 13.35 亿欧元收购 CECONOMY 的 59.8% 股本及投票权，收购按每股 4.6 欧元现金作出。连同京东集团合作伙伴 Convergenta 保留的 25.3% 股权，今次收购令双方对 CECONOMY 的持股比例合共达 85.2%。公告指，今次已完成所有要约条件，包括取得经营者集中审批、外商投资审批及欧盟外国补贴审批。京东集团表示，CECONOMY 将在欧洲保持独立营运，拥有当地独立技术架构，无计划调整人员、员工协议及办公地点；对方将成为京东集团子公司，今日起纳入集团合并财务报表。京东集团首席执行官许冉表示，双方有共同愿景，打造欧洲领先的新一代消费电子产品平台，合作伙伴关系将支持欧洲更广泛的创新及竞争力目标，有助打造更具活力的欧洲消费零售市场。CECONOMY 以 MediaMarkt、Saturn 及 MediaWorld 品牌，在 11 个市场经营逾 1,000 家消费电子产品店，同时经营线上零售业务，有逾 5 万名员工。

title.zh_hant: 杏花邨男生疑校內被襲擊　教育局要求學校跟進　警調查暫未有人被捕
title.en: Schoolboy allegedly assaulted at Hing Wah Estate school; Education Bureau asks school to follow up, police investigating with no arrests yet
title.zh_hans: 杏花邨男生疑校内被袭击　教育局要求学校跟进　警调查暂未有人被捕

summary.zh_hant: 一名13歲男生本周二在杏花邨一間學校內懷疑被人用手襲擊，清醒送院檢查。警方經初步調查後將案件列作「普通襲擊」，交由東區警區反三合會行動組跟進，暫未有人被捕。港島杏花邨嶺南中學表示，知悉事件後隨即啟動危機處理機制，展開調查及聯絡涉事學生家長，並於翌日陪同家長報警求助；校方正全力配合警方調查，並與教育局保持緊密聯繫，會為相關學生提供適切支援。教育局已要求學校跟進事件。
summary.en: A 13-year-old boy was allegedly struck by hand at a school in Hing Wah Estate on Tuesday and was taken to hospital conscious for examination. Police have classified the case as common assault after preliminary investigation and handed it to the Eastern District anti-triad unit; no one has been arrested so far. Lingnan Secondary School in Hing Wah Estate, Hong Kong Island, said it activated its crisis management mechanism as soon as it learned of the incident, investigated, contacted the parents of the pupils involved and accompanied the parents to report the case to police the next day. The school is fully co-operating with the police investigation, staying in close contact with the Education Bureau and will provide appropriate support to the pupils concerned. The Education Bureau has asked the school to follow up on the incident.
summary.zh_hans: 一名13岁男生本周二在杏花邨一间学校内怀疑被人用手袭击，清醒送院检查。警方经初步调查后将案件列作「普通袭击」，交由东区警区反三合会行动组跟进，暂未有人被捕。港岛杏花邨岭南中学表示，知悉事件后随即启动危机处理机制，展开调查及联络涉事学生家长，并于翌日陪同家长报警求助；校方正全力配合警方调查，并与教育局保持紧密联系，会为相关学生提供适切支援。教育局已要求学校跟进事件。

title.zh_hant: 內地「雙十一」全網電商銷售額約1.78萬億　按年升4.8%增速放緩
title.en: Mainland Singles' Day online sales reach about 1.78 trillion yuan, up 4.8% year on year as growth slows
title.zh_hans: 内地「双十一」全网电商销售额约1.78万亿　按年升4.8%增速放缓

summary.zh_hant: 線上零售數據分析平台星圖數據顯示，今年「雙十一」購物節內地全網電商銷售總額約1.78萬億元人民幣，按年升4.8%，增速較去年的14.2%放緩。報告涵蓋10月7日至11月11日期間的銷售數字，淘寶閃購、美團閃購、京東秒送等即時零售總銷售額891億元，按年升33%。報告指出，今年促銷規則進一步簡化，現貨銷售更突出，人工智能走向可交易商品模式，部分電商平台出售AI Token；京東指出，雙十一期間AI電腦、AI相機及眼鏡等成交額按年增長逾1倍，Token搜尋量及平台大模型Token包銷量都急升。
summary.en: Data from online retail analytics platform Syntun show that total online sales across the mainland during this year's Singles' Day shopping festival reached about 1.78 trillion yuan, up 4.8 per cent year on year, with growth slowing from 14.2 per cent last year. The report covers sales from October 7 to November 11, with instant retail — including Taobao Flash Purchase, Meituan Flash Purchase and JD Miaosong — totalling 89.1 billion yuan, up 33 per cent year on year. It noted simpler promotional rules this year, a stronger focus on in-stock sales, and artificial intelligence becoming a tradable product, with some e-commerce platforms selling AI tokens; JD said turnover of AI computers, AI cameras and glasses more than doubled year on year during Singles' Day, while token searches and sales of large-model token packages on its platform surged.
summary.zh_hans: 线上零售数据分析平台星图数据显示，今年「双十一」购物节内地全网电商销售总额约1.78万亿元人民币，按年升4.8%，增速较去年的14.2%放缓。报告涵盖10月7日至11月11日期间的销售数字，淘宝闪购、美团闪购、京东秒送等即时零售总销售额891亿元，按年升33%。报告指出，今年促销规则进一步简化，现货销售更突出，人工智能走向可交易商品模式，部分电商平台出售AI Token；京东指出，双十一期间AI电脑、AI相机及眼镜等成交额按年增长逾1倍，Token搜寻量及平台大模型Token包销量都急升。

title.zh_hant: 李強：完善靈活就業人員社保制度　逐步提高參保率
title.en: Li Qiang: improve social security system for flexible employment workers and gradually raise participation
title.zh_hans: 李强：完善灵活就业人员社保制度　逐步提高参保率

summary.zh_hant: 國務院總理李強表示，當前人口結構變化、技術進步及就業方式多樣化，對社會保障體系建設提出更高新要求，要完善靈活就業人員社會保障制度，逐步提高參保率，加強新就業形態人員權益保障。央視引述李強主持專題會議時指出，要增強社保基金長期可持續性，強化社保基金安全監管及保值增值，並適應形勢變化，及時修訂完善社會保障相關法律法規。他又提到，要推動社會保障制度更公平，穩步提高城鄉居民養老保障水平，健全分層分類的社會救助制度。
summary.en: Premier Li Qiang said that demographic changes, technological progress and more diverse forms of employment are placing new and higher demands on the social security system, calling for improvements to the social security system for flexible employment workers, a gradual rise in participation rates and stronger protection of the rights of workers in new forms of employment. State broadcaster CCTV quoted Li, chairing a special meeting, as saying the long-term sustainability of social security funds should be strengthened, their safety supervision and value preservation enhanced, and relevant laws and regulations revised in a timely way to keep pace with changing circumstances. He also called for a fairer social security system, steady increases in pension protection for urban and rural residents, and a tiered and categorised social assistance system.
summary.zh_hans: 国务院总理李强表示，当前人口结构变化、技术进步及就业方式多样化，对社会保障体系建设提出更高新要求，要完善灵活就业人员社会保障制度，逐步提高参保率，加强新就业形态人员权益保障。央视引述李强主持专题会议时指出，要增强社保基金长期可持续性，强化社保基金安全监管及保值增值，并适应形势变化，及时修订完善社会保障相关法律法规。他又提到，要推动社会保障制度更公平，稳步提高城乡居民养老保障水平，健全分层分类的社会救助制度。

title.zh_hant: 據報特朗普與內塔尼亞胡就是否對伊重啟軍事行動激烈爭吵
title.en: Trump and Netanyahu reportedly clash fiercely over whether to resume military action against Iran
title.zh_hans: 据报特朗普与内塔尼亚胡就是否对伊重启军事行动激烈争吵

summary.zh_hant: 美國霍士新聞引述以色列傳媒消息報道，總統特朗普與以色列看守政府總理內塔尼亞胡上周末通電話，圍繞是否對伊朗重啟軍事行動爆發激烈爭吵。報道指，內塔尼亞胡在通話中敦促特朗普重啟軍事行動，而特朗普則主張繼續以外交途徑推進與伊朗的談判。以色列總理辦公室回應指有關報道是假新聞，完全是無稽之談，否認通話具對抗性；有以色列高級官員則證實兩人曾經通話，但強調絕不是一場艱難的對話。報道又指，今次並非兩人第一次爭吵，特朗普今年6月因強烈不滿以方升級在黎巴嫩的軍事行動，曾在通話中怒斥內塔尼亞胡。
summary.en: Fox News, citing Israeli media, reported that US President Donald Trump and Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had a fierce argument during a phone call last weekend over whether to resume military action against Iran. The report said Netanyahu urged Trump to restart military action, while Trump argued for continuing to advance negotiations with Iran through diplomacy. The Israeli Prime Minister's Office responded that the report was fake news and completely absurd, denying the call was confrontational; a senior Israeli official confirmed the two had spoken but stressed it was by no means a difficult conversation. The report added that this was not the first time the two had clashed — Trump reportedly berated Netanyahu in a call in June after strongly objecting to Israel escalating military operations in Lebanon.
summary.zh_hans: 美国霍士新闻引述以色列传媒消息报道，总统特朗普与以色列看守政府总理内塔尼亚胡上周末通电话，围绕是否对伊朗重启军事行动爆发激烈争吵。报道指，内塔尼亚胡在通话中敦促特朗普重启军事行动，而特朗普则主张继续以外交途径推进与伊朗的谈判。以色列总理办公室回应指有关报道是假新闻，完全是无稽之谈，否认通话具对抗性；有以色列高级官员则证实两人曾经通话，但强调绝不是一场艰难的对话。报道又指，今次并非两人第一次争吵，特朗普今年6月因强烈不满以方升级在黎巴嫩的军事行动，曾在通话中怒斥内塔尼亚胡。

title.zh_hant: 孫中山誕辰160周年　習近平於大會前接見孫中山親屬及來賓代表
title.en: Xi meets Sun Yat-sen's relatives and guest representatives before ceremony marking 160th anniversary of his birth
title.zh_hans: 孙中山诞辰160周年　习近平于大会前接见孙中山亲属及来宾代表

summary.zh_hant: 紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年大會今日上午在北京人民大會堂舉行，中共中央總書記、國家主席、中央軍委主席習近平出席紀念大會前，接見孫中山先生親屬及海外來賓代表。央視新聞聯播畫面顯示，出席者包括全國人大常委李慧琼、行政會議召集人葉劉淑儀、全國政協常委吳良好，以及港區全國人大代表、孫中山先生後人孫偉勇等。參加紀念活動的孫中山先生親屬及海外來賓、台灣人士其後亦到北京香山碧雲寺，參加晉謁孫中山先生衣冠塚儀式，全國政協、中共中央統戰部、民革中央、北京市人民政府和孫中山先生親屬代表依次向孫中山先生像敬獻花籃。
summary.en: A ceremony marking the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing this morning, and Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, met relatives of Dr Sun and representatives of overseas guests before attending the ceremony. Footage on CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo showed those present included National People's Congress Standing Committee member Starry Lee Wai-king, Executive Council convenor Regina Ip Lau Suk-yee, Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Standing Committee member Ng Leung-ho, and Hong Kong deputy to the National People's Congress Sun Weiyong, a descendant of Dr Sun. Relatives of Dr Sun, overseas guests and people from Taiwan taking part in the commemorative events later visited the Biyun Temple on Fragrant Hills in Beijing for a ceremony paying respects at Dr Sun's tomb of clothes and cap, where representatives of the CPPCC National Committee, the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang Central Committee, the Beijing Municipal People's Government and Dr Sun's relatives laid flower baskets before his statue in turn.
summary.zh_hans: 纪念孙中山先生诞辰160周年大会今日上午在北京人民大会堂举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平出席纪念大会前，接见孙中山先生亲属及海外来宾代表。央视新闻联播画面显示，出席者包括全国人大常委李慧琼、行政会议召集人叶刘淑仪、全国政协常委吴良好，以及港区全国人大代表、孙中山先生后人孙伟勇等。参加纪念活动的孙中山先生亲属及海外来宾、台湾人士其后亦到北京香山碧云寺，参加晋谒孙中山先生衣冠冢仪式，全国政协、中共中央统战部、民革中央、北京市人民政府和孙中山先生亲属代表依次向孙中山先生像敬献花篮。

title.zh_hant: 瑪麗醫院新大樓28部升降機18部完成執修　餘下預計第四季完成
title.en: 18 of 28 lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new block repaired; rest expected to be completed in fourth quarter
title.zh_hans: 玛丽医院新大楼28部升降机18部完成执修　余下预计第四季完成

summary.zh_hant: 立法會發展事務委員會明日舉行特別會議，政府將交代瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程問題的調查報告結果及後續跟進行動。發展局向立法會提交的文件指出，執修工作正全速進行，截至本周二，28部升降機中有18部已完成執修，當中有7部經驗收後已按醫院需要開放給員工和公眾使用；按目前進度，預計第四季內可完成餘下升降機的執修。醫管局正與建築署和機電工程營運基金籌備服務調遷和新大樓啟用的準備工作，並強調所有28部升降機須全部運作正常，新大樓才會全面展開服務。發展局又提到，建築署已加強升降機工程檢驗程序、提升工地檢測頻率及加強數碼工程監督系統功能；機電署會即時擴大實地覆測查驗範疇，除了現時有關安全的項目，也會為涵蓋有機會影響升降機運作和功能的關鍵項目由機電署人員實地抽查。
summary.en: The Legislative Council's Panel on Development will hold a special meeting tomorrow, at which the Government will present the findings of the investigation into the lift works at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block and follow-up actions. A Development Bureau paper submitted to LegCo said remedial works are proceeding at full speed and, as of Tuesday this week, 18 of the 28 lifts had been rectified, of which seven have passed acceptance checks and been opened for staff and public use as the hospital requires; at the current pace, the remaining lifts are expected to be rectified within the fourth quarter. The Hospital Authority is working with the Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund on preparations for service relocation and the new block's opening, stressing that all 28 lifts must be fully operational before the new block enters full service. The bureau added that the Architectural Services Department has strengthened lift works inspection procedures, increased site inspection frequency and enhanced its digital works supervision system, while the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department will immediately widen the scope of on-site re-testing to include key items that could affect lift operation and function, with its own staff carrying out spot checks.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会发展事务委员会明日举行特别会议，政府将交代玛丽医院新临床大楼升降机工程问题的调查报告结果及后续跟进行动。发展局向立法会提交的文件指出，执修工作正全速进行，截至本周二，28部升降机中有18部已完成执修，当中有7部经验收后已按医院需要开放给员工和公众使用；按目前进度，预计第四季内可完成余下升降机的执修。医管局正与建筑署和机电工程营运基金筹备服务调迁和新大楼启用的准备工作，并强调所有28部升降机须全部运作正常，新大楼才会全面展开服务。发展局又提到，建筑署已加强升降机工程检验程序、提升工地检测频率及加强数码工程监督系统功能；机电署会即时扩大实地覆测查验范畴，除了现时有关安全的项目，也会为涵盖有机会影响升降机运作和功能的关键项目由机电署人员实地抽查。

title.zh_hant: 伊朗高官：美國若再動武　參與的西亞及歐洲基地將成致命打擊目標
title.en: Iranian official: if US launches war again, bases in West Asia and Europe taking part will be legitimate targets for deadly strikes
title.zh_hans: 伊朗高官：美国若再动武　参与的西亚及欧洲基地将成致命打击目标

summary.zh_hant: 伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊當地星期四在社交平台表示，如果美國再對伊朗發動戰事，參與侵略的每個軍事基地，從西亞到歐洲都將成為伊朗致命打擊的合法目標，沒有安全之地。伊斯蘭革命衛隊航空航天部隊在首都德黑蘭舉辦展覽，展示伊朗自主研發的彈道導彈、高超音速導彈、無人機、運載火箭及航空航天領域技術成果，又展示被擊落的美國和以色列裝備。革命衛隊航空航天部隊司令顧問巴拉利表示，展出的裝備較伊朗武裝部隊目前實際列裝的裝備在技術水平上滯後5至6年，目前擁有更先進、更現代化的裝備，但未有展出。
summary.en: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said on social media on Thursday local time that if the United States launches war against Iran again, every military base taking part in the aggression, from West Asia to Europe, will become a legitimate target for Iran's deadly strikes, with nowhere safe. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' Aerospace Force held an exhibition in the capital Tehran showcasing Iran's self-developed ballistic missiles, hypersonic missiles, drones, carrier rockets and aerospace technology, as well as downed American and Israeli equipment. Barali, an adviser to the commander of the Aerospace Force, said the equipment on display lags five to six years behind what Iran's armed forces actually field, and that more advanced and modern equipment is already in service but was not exhibited.
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊当地星期四在社交平台表示，如果美国再对伊朗发动战事，参与侵略的每个军事基地，从西亚到欧洲都将成为伊朗致命打击的合法目标，没有安全之地。伊斯兰革命卫队航空航天部队在首都德黑兰举办展览，展示伊朗自主研发的弹道导弹、高超音速导弹、无人机、运载火箭及航空航天领域技术成果，又展示被击落的美国和以色列装备。革命卫队航空航天部队司令顾问巴拉利表示，展出的装备较伊朗武装部队目前实际列装的装备在技术水平上滞后5至6年，目前拥有更先进、更现代化的装备，但未有展出。

title.zh_hant: HPV疫苗補種計劃下月底完結　衞生署籲合資格女性盡快完成接種
title.en: HPV vaccination catch-up programme to end at end of next month; Department of Health urges eligible women to complete vaccination soon
title.zh_hans: HPV疫苗补种计划下月底完结　卫生署吁合资格女性尽快完成接种

summary.zh_hant: 政府於2024年推出的一次性人類乳頭瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗補種計劃將於今年12月31日結束，衞生署衞生防護中心呼籲已接種第一劑疫苗的合資格女性香港居民把握時間，完成餘下接種，以免錯過免費接種的最後機會。補種計劃下，在2004年至2008年出生而未完成接種HPV疫苗的合資格女性可免費接種兩劑疫苗，免疫力弱的人士則需接種三劑，兩劑建議相隔至少五個月；合資格人士可先登記「醫健通」，再透過網頁或電話（2855 1333）預約到樂妍站或指定地區康健中心／站接種。衞生防護中心總監徐樂堅表示，補種計劃推出將近兩年，累計接種超過74,000劑疫苗；接種HPV疫苗可有效預防可致命的子宮頸癌，世界衞生組織及海外衞生部門已確認疫苗安全有效。子宮頸癌於本港女性致命癌症中排第九位，2024年有160名女性死於此癌症；疫苗對HPV 16型和18型的保護力逾九成。
summary.en: The Government's one-off Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination Catch-up Programme, launched in 2024, will end on December 31, 2026, and the Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health has urged eligible women who have received the first dose to complete the remaining doses in time so as not to miss the final opportunity for free vaccination. Under the programme, eligible female Hong Kong residents born between 2004 and 2008 who have not completed HPV vaccination can receive two doses free of charge, while immunocompromised persons need three doses, all free; the recommended interval between the two doses is at least five months. Eligible women who have registered an eHealth account can book online or by phone (2855 1333) for vaccination at Women Wellness Satellites or designated District Health Centres or DHC Express. Controller of the Centre for Health Protection Dr Edwin Tsui said the programme has been running for nearly two years with more than 74,000 doses administered, and that HPV vaccination effectively prevents life-threatening cervical cancer, with the World Health Organization and overseas health authorities confirming the vaccine is safe and effective. Cervical cancer ranks ninth among cancer deaths in females in Hong Kong, with 160 deaths recorded in 2024; the vaccine offers over 90 per cent protection against HPV types 16 and 18.
summary.zh_hans: 政府于2024年推出的一次性人类乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗补种计划将于今年12月31日结束，卫生署卫生防护中心呼吁已接种第一剂疫苗的合资格女性香港居民把握时间，完成余下接种，以免错过免费接种的最后机会。补种计划下，在2004年至2008年出生而未完成接种HPV疫苗的合资格女性可免费接种两剂疫苗，免疫力弱的人士则需接种三剂，两剂建议相隔至少五个月；合资格人士可先登记「医健通」，再透过网页或电话（2855 1333）预约到乐妍站或指定地区康健中心／站接种。卫生防护中心总监徐乐坚表示，补种计划推出将近两年，累计接种超过74,000剂疫苗；接种HPV疫苗可有效预防可致命的子宫颈癌，世界卫生组织及海外卫生部门已确认疫苗安全有效。子宫颈癌于本港女性致命癌症中排第九位，2024年有160名女性死于此癌症；疫苗对HPV 16型和18型的保护力逾九成。

title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸開通一個月　出入境人員334萬人次
title.en: New Huanggang Port records 3.34 million crossings in first month of operation
title.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸开通一个月　出入境人员334万人次

summary.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸開通一個月，深圳邊檢總站表示，首月共錄得出入境人員334萬人次，日均逾11萬人次，較口岸升級前升逾一倍。深港雙方近期已在多個口岸設立亞太經合組織峰會的專用櫃枱，運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，會提供清晰訊息及指示，讓旅客高效過關直接抵達會議會場。
summary.en: The new Huanggang Port has been open for one month, and the Shenzhen General Station of Immigration Inspection said it recorded 3.34 million inbound and outbound travellers in the first month, averaging more than 110,000 a day — more than double the level before the port's upgrade. Hong Kong and Shenzhen have recently set up dedicated APEC summit counters at a number of ports; Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said clear information and directions will be provided so travellers can clear immigration efficiently and head straight to the meeting venues.
summary.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸开通一个月，深圳边检总站表示，首月共录得出入境人员334万人次，日均逾11万人次，较口岸升级前升逾一倍。深港双方近期已在多个口岸设立亚太经合组织峰会的专用柜枱，运输及物流局局长陈美宝表示，会提供清晰讯息及指示，让旅客高效过关直接抵达会议会场。

title.zh_hant: 紐約有建築物倒塌　釀最少兩死十多人傷
title.en: Building collapse in New York kills at least two and injures more than a dozen
title.zh_hans: 纽约有建筑物倒塌　酿最少两死十多人伤

summary.zh_hant: 美國紐約布魯克林區一棟有90多年歷史的三層高建築物倒塌，最少兩人死亡，十多人受傷。當局正調查事故原因，又透露事發時倒塌建築物旁的地盤正進行挖掘工程。
summary.en: A three-storey building more than 90 years old collapsed in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least two people and injuring more than a dozen. Authorities are investigating the cause and said excavation work was under way at a construction site next to the collapsed building at the time.
summary.zh_hans: 美国纽约布鲁克林区一栋有90多年历史的三层高建筑物倒塌，最少两人死亡，十多人受伤。当局正调查事故原因，又透露事发时倒塌建筑物旁的地盘正进行挖掘工程。

title.zh_hant: 印尼發行百億元人民幣主權熊貓債　7年期債首次面世
title.en: Indonesia issues 10 billion yuan in sovereign panda bonds, with seven-year tenor debuting
title.zh_hans: 印尼发行百亿元人民币主权熊猫债　7年期债首次面世

summary.zh_hant: 印尼在中國銀行間債券市場發行100億元人民幣主權熊貓債，創銀行間債市主權熊貓債發行規模新高。牽頭主承銷商及牽頭簿記管理人中金公司表示，印尼發行的熊貓債涵蓋3個年期，3年期發行規模57億元，票面利率1.96厘；5年期佔37億元，票面利率2.15厘；7年期佔6億元，票面利率2.5厘。中金公司指出，過往主權熊貓債以3年及5年期為主，今次首次發行7年期品種，相信可以補齊主權熊貓債長期限短板，完善市場孳息率曲線，亦幫助發行人鎖定中長期融資成本，獲取穩定的中長期人民幣資金，優化外債期限結構。據外電報道，今年7月下旬印尼亦在中國銀行間市場發行70億元人民幣熊貓債，涵蓋3年及5年期，票面利率分別1.9厘及2.19厘。
summary.en: Indonesia has issued 10 billion yuan of sovereign panda bonds in China's interbank bond market, a record for sovereign panda bond issuance in the interbank market. Lead underwriter and lead bookrunner CICC said the bonds span three tenors: three-year bonds of 5.7 billion yuan at a 1.96 per cent coupon, five-year bonds of 3.7 billion yuan at 2.15 per cent, and seven-year bonds of 600 million yuan at 2.5 per cent. CICC noted that sovereign panda bonds have previously been mainly three- and five-year issues, and the debut seven-year tenor should fill the gap at the long end, improve the market yield curve, help the issuer lock in medium- to long-term funding costs, secure stable medium- to long-term yuan funding and optimise its external debt maturity structure. Foreign media reported that Indonesia also issued 7 billion yuan of panda bonds in the mainland interbank market in late July this year, in three- and five-year tenors at 1.9 per cent and 2.19 per cent respectively.
summary.zh_hans: 印尼在中国银行间债券市场发行100亿元人民币主权熊猫债，创银行间债市主权熊猫债发行规模新高。牵头主承销商及牵头簿记管理人中金公司表示，印尼发行的熊猫债涵盖3个年期，3年期发行规模57亿元，票面利率1.96厘；5年期占37亿元，票面利率2.15厘；7年期占6亿元，票面利率2.5厘。中金公司指出，过往主权熊猫债以3年及5年期为主，今次首次发行7年期品种，相信可以补齐主权熊猫债长期限短板，完善市场孳息率曲线，亦帮助发行人锁定中长期融资成本，获取稳定的中长期人民币资金，优化外债期限结构。据外电报道，今年7月下旬印尼亦在中国银行间市场发行70亿元人民币熊猫债，涵盖3年及5年期，票面利率分别1.9厘及2.19厘。

title.zh_hant: 瑪麗醫院升降機報告：頻繁故障涉四原因　其他違法行為已轉交調查
title.en: Queen Mary Hospital lift report: frequent breakdowns linked to four causes; other suspected offences referred for investigation
title.zh_hans: 玛丽医院升降机报告：频繁故障涉四原因　其他违法行为已转交调查

summary.zh_hant: 立法會發展事務委員會明日舉行特別會議，政府將交代瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程問題的調查報告結果及後續跟進行動。發展局向立法會提交的文件指出，所有28部升降機均出現不同程度的問題，出現頻繁故障的主因包括升降機井道牆身尺寸和垂直度出現偏差、升降機導軌垂直度在不同樓層出現偏差、升降機機廂重心不平衡導致機廂不完全垂直，以及升降機安裝工藝質素欠妥。發展局將按規管機制啟動內部程序，分別向涉事承建商、分判商和顧問公司採取進一步懲處行動；由於調查過程中發現事件有可能涉及其他違法行為，局方已交由有關執法部門進一步調查。文件又指出，工程問題按現行監察機制理應可及早發現並作出糾正，但未有在施工階段得到應有重視和及時跟進；承建商安保在事件中出現多項過失，包括施工失準、工藝欠妥及跟進馬虎。建築署項目團隊在去年1月未有嚴謹依照內部指引比對「必要工程項目檢查清單」，在尚有升降機未獲發准用證的情況下批出完工證明書；發展局已要求建築署署長根據《公務員事務規例》對涉事人員作出適當處理。
summary.en: The Legislative Council's Panel on Development will hold a special meeting tomorrow, at which the Government will present the findings of the investigation into the lift works at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block and follow-up actions. A Development Bureau paper to LegCo said all 28 lifts had problems of varying degrees, and the main causes of the frequent breakdowns were deviations in the size and verticality of the lift shaft walls, deviations in the verticality of the lift guide rails across different floors, an unbalanced centre of gravity in the lift cars causing them to sit off-vertical, and poor workmanship in lift installation. The bureau will initiate internal procedures under the regulatory regime to take further disciplinary action against the contractor, subcontractors and consultants involved; as the investigation suggested possible other offences, the matter has been referred to the relevant law enforcement agencies. The paper added that the works problems should have been spotted and rectified early under the existing monitoring regime but were not given due attention or timely follow-up during construction, and contractor Anbao committed multiple faults including inaccurate works, poor workmanship and sloppy follow-up. The Architectural Services Department's project team failed in January last year to rigorously follow internal guidelines in checking the 'Checklist of Essential Works Items' and issued a completion certificate while some lifts had yet to receive use permits; the Development Bureau has asked the Director of Architectural Services to take appropriate action against the staff concerned under the Civil Service Regulations.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会发展事务委员会明日举行特别会议，政府将交代玛丽医院新临床大楼升降机工程问题的调查报告结果及后续跟进行动。发展局向立法会提交的文件指出，所有28部升降机均出现不同程度的问题，出现频繁故障的主因包括升降机井道墙身尺寸和垂直度出现偏差、升降机导轨垂直度在不同楼层出现偏差、升降机机厢重心不平衡导致机厢不完全垂直，以及升降机安装工艺质素欠妥。发展局将按规管机制启动内部程序，分别向涉事承建商、分判商和顾问公司采取进一步惩处行动；由于调查过程中发现事件有可能涉及其他违法行为，局方已交由有关执法部门进一步调查。文件又指出，工程问题按现行监察机制理应可及早发现并作出纠正，但未有在施工阶段得到应有重视和及时跟进；承建商安保在事件中出现多项过失，包括施工失准、工艺欠妥及跟进马虎。建筑署项目团队在去年1月未有严谨依照内部指引比对「必要工程项目检查清单」，在尚有升降机未获发准用证的情况下批出完工证明书；发展局已要求建筑署署长根据《公务员事务规例》对涉事人员作出适当处理。

title.zh_hant: 中芯第3季盈利按年急升1.2倍　按季跌近11%
title.en: SMIC's third-quarter profit surges 1.2 times year on year but falls nearly 11% quarter on quarter
title.zh_hans: 中芯第3季盈利按年急升1.2倍　按季跌近11%

summary.zh_hant: 中芯國際第3季盈利4.28億美元，按年急升1.23倍，按季下跌10.6%。上季收入31.9億美元，按年及按季分別增長33.9%和6.1%；毛利率29.9%，按年升7.9個百分點，按季升4.6個百分點。集團預計，第4季收入按季增長4%至6%，毛利率指引介乎26%至28%。
summary.en: SMIC's third-quarter profit was US$428 million, surging 1.23 times year on year but falling 10.6 per cent quarter on quarter. Revenue last quarter was US$3.19 billion, up 33.9 per cent year on year and 6.1 per cent quarter on quarter, with a gross margin of 29.9 per cent, up 7.9 percentage points year on year and 4.6 percentage points quarter on quarter. The group expects fourth-quarter revenue to grow 4 to 6 per cent quarter on quarter, with gross margin guidance of 26 to 28 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 中芯国际第3季盈利4.28亿美元，按年急升1.23倍，按季下跌10.6%。上季收入31.9亿美元，按年及按季分别增长33.9%和6.1%；毛利率29.9%，按年升7.9个百分点，按季升4.6个百分点。集团预计，第4季收入按季增长4%至6%，毛利率指引介乎26%至28%。

title.zh_hant: 商務部：堅決反對將技術問題政治化　冀為企業提供公平營商環境
title.en: Commerce Ministry: firmly opposes politicising technical issues and hopes for a fair business environment for enterprises
title.zh_hans: 商务部：坚决反对将技术问题政治化　冀为企业提供公平营商环境

summary.zh_hant: 商務部在例行新聞發布會回應歐盟有關國家禁用中國企業設備的問題，新聞發言人何亞東表示，中方注意到有關報道，已向相關國家政府表達嚴重關切。何亞東說，中方一貫認為，5G是全球數字經濟發展的重要基礎設施，建設和運營應尊重市場規律、技術中立和國際規則；中方堅決反對將技術問題政治化、泛安全化，希望相關國家及時糾正錯誤做法，為中國企業提供公平、公正、非歧視的營商環境。
summary.en: At a regular press briefing, the Ministry of Commerce responded to questions about some EU member states banning equipment from Chinese companies, with spokesman He Yadong saying China has noted the reports and expressed serious concern to the governments concerned. He said China has consistently held that 5G is important infrastructure for the development of the global digital economy and that its construction and operation should respect market rules, technological neutrality and international rules; China firmly opposes politicising and over-securitising technical issues and hopes the countries concerned will promptly correct their wrong practices and provide a fair, just and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese enterprises.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部在例行新闻发布会回应欧盟有关国家禁用中国企业设备的问题，新闻发言人何亚东表示，中方注意到有关报道，已向相关国家政府表达严重关切。何亚东说，中方一贯认为，5G是全球数字经济发展的重要基础设施，建设和运营应尊重市场规律、技术中立和国际规则；中方坚决反对将技术问题政治化、泛安全化，希望相关国家及时纠正错误做法，为中国企业提供公平、公正、非歧视的营商环境。

title.zh_hant: 天文台：冷空氣南下　下周三氣溫顯著下降
title.en: Observatory: cold air moving south; temperatures to fall markedly next Wednesday
title.zh_hans: 天文台：冷空气南下　下周三气温显著下降

summary.zh_hant: 天文台表示，隨著冷空氣南下，預料一道冷鋒會在下周二於華南內陸形成並向南移動，受隨後的東北季候風影響，下周三本港將轉吹偏北風，氣溫顯著下降，下周中後期華南沿岸氣溫將再度降至20度以下，但會否達到本周初的溫度甚至更低仍有待觀察。天文台提醒，未來一周天氣會有較大轉變，市民應密切留意天氣變化。天文台又預料，廣東地區天氣在未來一兩日變得不穩定，有驟雨及雷暴，明晚驟雨增多及有幾陣狂風雷暴，風勢增強，周六初時雨勢頗大。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory said that as cold air moves south, a cold front is expected to form over inland southern China next Tuesday and move southwards; under the ensuing northeast monsoon, Hong Kong will turn to northerly winds next Wednesday with temperatures falling markedly, and temperatures along the southern China coast are expected to drop below 20 degrees again in the middle to latter part of next week, though whether they will reach the levels seen earlier this week or lower remains to be seen. The Observatory reminded the public that the weather will change significantly over the coming week and to watch for updates. It also forecast unsettled weather over Guangdong in the next day or two, with showers and thunderstorms; showers will become more frequent tomorrow evening with a few squally thunderstorms and strengthening winds, and heavy rain is expected early on Saturday.
summary.zh_hans: 天文台表示，随着冷空气南下，预料一道冷锋会在下周二于华南内陆形成并向南移动，受随后的东北季候风影响，下周三本港将转吹偏北风，气温显著下降，下周中后期华南沿岸气温将再度降至20度以下，但会否达到本周初的温度甚至更低仍有待观察。天文台提醒，未来一周天气会有较大转变，市民应密切留意天气变化。天文台又预料，广东地区天气在未来一两日变得不稳定，有骤雨及雷暴，明晚骤雨增多及有几阵狂风雷暴，风势增强，周六初时雨势颇大。

title.zh_hant: 立法會否決梁文廣優化公屋政策議案　兩修正案同被否決
title.en: LegCo votes down Leung Man-kwong's motion on improving public housing policy; two amendments also rejected
title.zh_hans: 立法会否决梁文广优化公屋政策议案　两修正案同被否决

summary.zh_hant: 立法會否決由九龍西議員梁文廣提出的「優化公營房屋政策，促進市民向上流動」議員議案，民建聯陳學鋒和工聯會林偉江提出的修正案同樣被否決。梁文廣建議政府重推出售公屋計劃，回應基層置業需求，並研究為公屋富戶設立專項儲蓄計劃，增加置業誘因。多名議員表示有保留，認為在租置計劃研究報告有結果之前，不應貿然重推；為公屋富戶設立專項儲蓄計劃亦不符合公屋政策原意。財政司副司長兼署理房屋局局長黃偉綸表示，整體公屋綜合輪候時間已回落至今年6月底的4.8年，連續兩季處於8年多以來最低水平，政府有信心達到至2026/27年度輪候時間降至4.5年的目標；房屋局已於10月展開租置調研，向全港逾14,000個住戶發放問卷，預計最快明年公布結果。
summary.en: The Legislative Council voted down a motion moved by Kowloon West member Leung Man-kwong on improving public housing policy to promote upward mobility, and amendments proposed by the DAB's Chan Hok-fung and the FTU's Lam Wai-keung were also rejected. Leung proposed that the Government relaunch the sale of public rental housing to meet grassroots home-ownership demand, and study a dedicated savings scheme for well-off public housing tenants to encourage home purchase. Several members expressed reservations, arguing the Tenants Purchase Scheme should not be hastily relaunched before the findings of its study are available, and that a savings scheme for well-off tenants runs against the original intent of public housing policy. Financial Secretary's deputy and acting Secretary for Housing Michael Wong Wai-lun said overall public rental housing waiting time has fallen to 4.8 years as of end-June, the lowest in more than eight years for two consecutive quarters, and the Government is confident of meeting its target of 4.5 years by 2026/27; the Housing Bureau launched a study in October, sending questionnaires to over 14,000 households across Hong Kong, with results expected earliest next year.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会否决由九龙西议员梁文广提出的「优化公营房屋政策，促进市民向上流动」议员议案，民建联陈学锋和工联会林伟江提出的修正案同样被否决。梁文广建议政府重推出售公屋计划，回应基层置业需求，并研究为公屋富户设立专项储蓄计划，增加置业诱因。多名议员表示有保留，认为在租置计划研究报告有结果之前，不应贸然重推；为公屋富户设立专项储蓄计划亦不符合公屋政策原意。财政司副司长兼署理房屋局局长黄伟纶表示，整体公屋综合轮候时间已回落至今年6月底的4.8年，连续两季处于8年多以来最低水平，政府有信心达到至2026/27年度轮候时间降至4.5年的目标；房屋局已于10月展开租置调研，向全港逾14,000个住户发放问卷，预计最快明年公布结果。

title.zh_hant: 中方奉勸七國集團管好自己事情　為促進國際團結發揮正面作用
title.en: China urges G7 to mind its own business and play a positive role in promoting international solidarity
title.zh_hans: 中方奉劝七国集团管好自己事情　为促进国际团结发挥正面作用

summary.zh_hant: 外交部發言人毛寧在例行記者會回應七國集團涉台相關聲明時表示，有關聲明無視客觀事實，無視中國為世界和平穩定與發展所做的積極貢獻，粗暴干涉中國內政，惡意污衊抹黑中國。毛寧指出，有關內容言辭荒謬，再次證明七國集團是抱守冷戰思維、搞集團政治的意識形態小圈子，完全不能代表國際社會。她強調，中方在台灣等問題上的立場一貫明確、正當合理和光明磊落，奉勸七國集團管好自己的事情，履行好自身責任，為應對當今各種緊迫挑戰、促進國際團結多發揮正面作用。
summary.en: Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning, responding at a regular press briefing to a G7 statement on Taiwan, said the statement disregarded objective facts and China's positive contributions to world peace, stability and development, grossly interfered in China's internal affairs and maliciously smeared China. Mao said the wording was absurd and proved once again that the G7 is an ideological clique clinging to Cold War thinking and bloc politics that cannot represent the international community. She stressed that China's position on Taiwan and other issues has always been clear, legitimate and above board, urging the G7 to mind its own business, fulfil its own responsibilities and play a more positive role in tackling today's pressing challenges and promoting international solidarity.
summary.zh_hans: 外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会回应七国集团涉台相关声明时表示，有关声明无视客观事实，无视中国为世界和平稳定与发展所做的积极贡献，粗暴干涉中国内政，恶意污蔑抹黑中国。毛宁指出，有关内容言辞荒谬，再次证明七国集团是抱守冷战思维、搞集团政治的意识形态小圈子，完全不能代表国际社会。她强调，中方在台湾等问题上的立场一贯明确、正当合理和光明磊落，奉劝七国集团管好自己的事情，履行好自身责任，为应对当今各种紧迫挑战、促进国际团结多发挥正面作用。

title.zh_hant: 食環署「雷霆行動」精準滅鼠　已核查1373個位置捕獲103隻活鼠
title.en: FEHD's 'Thunder Operation' targets rat hotspots; 1,373 sites checked, 103 live rats caught
title.zh_hans: 食环署「雷霆行动」精准灭鼠　已核查1373个位置捕获103只活鼠

summary.zh_hant: 食環署表示，已於本月4日展開「雷霆行動」，主動針對鼠患較嚴重的地點及其他高風險位置，循鼠隻活動路徑追查巢穴及主要藏匿位置，集中力量精準滅鼠，採取捕鼠、施放殺鼠劑及封堵鼠洞等措施。行動首階段重點治理位置包括公園、休憩用地、綠化帶、斜坡，以及食肆後巷和垃圾收集站周邊等高風險位置，署方亦會安排夜間防治鼠患流動隊在鼠隻活躍時段加強滅鼠。自行動展開以來，食環署已在全港核查1373個位置，發現199個鼠洞或老鼠藏匿點、捕獲103隻活鼠、收集51隻死鼠，並已在92個位置完成毒殺老鼠及封堵相關鼠洞。署方又嚴肅跟進鼠患嚴重的私人處所，觀塘成業街一幢工業大廈夜間滅鼠隊首晚已捕獲超過50隻老鼠，針對藏匿點的滅鼠行動仍在進行中。
summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it launched 'Thunder Operation' on November 4, proactively targeting locations with serious rat problems and other high-risk spots, tracing rat nests and hiding places along their activity routes and concentrating resources on precise rat control through trapping, rodenticides and sealing rat holes. The first phase focuses on parks, rest gardens, green belts, slopes, restaurant back alleys and areas around refuse collection points, with night-time mobile rat-control teams deployed during peak rat activity. Since the operation began, the department has checked 1,373 locations across Hong Kong, finding 199 rat holes or hiding places, catching 103 live rats and collecting 51 dead rats, and has completed poisoning and sealing at 92 locations. The department is also strictly following up on private premises with serious infestations; at an industrial building on Shing Yip Street in Kwun Tong, the night team caught more than 50 rats on its first night, and work on the hiding places there continues.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署表示，已于本月4日展开「雷霆行动」，主动针对鼠患较严重的地点及其他高风险位置，循鼠只活动路径追查巢穴及主要藏匿位置，集中力量精准灭鼠，采取捕鼠、施放杀鼠剂及封堵鼠洞等措施。行动首阶段重点治理位置包括公园、休憩用地、绿化带、斜坡，以及食肆后巷和垃圾收集站周边等高风险位置，署方亦会安排夜间防治鼠患流动队在鼠只活跃时段加强灭鼠。自行动展开以来，食环署已在全港核查1373个位置，发现199个鼠洞或老鼠藏匿点、捕获103只活鼠、收集51只死鼠，并已在92个位置完成毒杀老鼠及封堵相关鼠洞。署方又严肃跟进鼠患严重的私人处所，观塘成业街一幢工业大厦夜间灭鼠队首晚已捕获超过50只老鼠，针对藏匿点的灭鼠行动仍在进行中。

title.zh_hant: 許正宇：本港家族辦公室逾3380間　目標2026至2028年再增至少220間
title.en: Christopher Hui: Hong Kong has over 3,380 single family offices; target at least 220 more from 2026 to 2028
title.zh_hans: 许正宇：本港家族办公室逾3380间　目标2026至2028年再增至少220间

summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長許正宇在香港家族辦公室峰會致辭時表示，香港現為全球最大跨境財富管理中心，資產及財富管理業務截至2025年底達5.4萬億美元，當中54%資金來自香港及內地以外的投資者；家族辦公室及私人信託客戶的私人銀行及私人財富管理業務達2,720億美元，按年升37%。政府2022至2025年協助至少200間家族辦公室在港設立或擴展業務的目標已提前達標，截至2025年底本港單一家族辦公室逾3,380間，兩年間增加約680間，升逾25%；單一家族辦公室每年為本地經濟貢獻約16億美元，直接聘用逾10,000名全職專業人員。政府提出2026至2028年進一步協助至少220間家族辦公室在港設立或擴展業務，較原目標增加10%；新資本投資者入境計劃至今接獲逾5,000宗申請，如全部獲批預計為香港帶來1,500億港元。
summary.en: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said at the Family Office Summit in Hong Kong that the city is now the world's largest cross-boundary wealth management centre, with asset and wealth management business reaching US$5.4 trillion at the end of 2025, 54 percent of funding coming from investors outside Hong Kong and the Chinese mainland; private banking and private wealth management business attributable to family offices and private trust clients amounted to US$272 billion, up 37 percent year on year. The Government's target of facilitating at least 200 family offices to set up or expand in Hong Kong between 2022 and 2025 was achieved ahead of schedule, with more than 3,380 single family offices operating in Hong Kong at the end of 2025, an increase of about 680 over two years, or more than 25 percent; single family offices contribute about US$1.6 billion a year to the local economy and directly employ more than 10,000 full-time professionals. The Government now aims to facilitate at least 220 more family offices from 2026 to 2028, 10 percent above the previous target, and the New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme has received more than 5,000 applications, expected to bring HK$150 billion to Hong Kong if all are approved.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长许正宇在香港家族办公室峰会致辞时表示，香港现为全球最大跨境财富管理中心，资产及财富管理业务截至2025年底达5.4万亿美元，当中54%资金来自香港及内地以外的投资者；家族办公室及私人信托客户的私人银行及私人财富管理业务达2,720亿美元，按年升37%。政府2022至2025年协助至少200间家族办公室在港设立或扩展业务的目标已提前达标，截至2025年底本港单一家族办公室逾3,380间，两年间增加约680间，升逾25%；单一家族办公室每年为本地经济贡献约16亿美元，直接聘用逾10,000名全职专业人员。政府提出2026至2028年进一步协助至少220间家族办公室在港设立或扩展业务，较原目标增加10%；新资本投资者入境计划至今接获逾5,000宗申请，如全部获批预计为香港带来1,500亿港元。

title.zh_hant: 韓國外長趙顯明日訪華兩日　中方願落實兩國元首共識
title.en: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun to visit China tomorrow for two days; Beijing pledges to implement leaders' consensus
title.zh_hans: 韩国外长赵显明日访华两日　中方愿落实两国元首共识

summary.zh_hant: 外交部宣布，經中韓雙方商定，韓國外長趙顯明日訪華兩日。發言人毛寧在例行記者會表示，國家主席習近平與韓國總統李在明在去年底、今年初成功實現互訪，引領中韓關係進入改善發展的新階段。中方很重視趙顯的訪問，願意同韓方一起落實好兩國元首的重要共識，就雙邊關係和共同關心的問題深入交換意見，推動中韓戰略合作伙伴關係持續健康穩定發展。
summary.en: The Foreign Ministry announced that, as agreed by China and South Korea, South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun will visit China tomorrow for two days. Spokeswoman Mao Ning said at a regular press briefing that President Xi Jinping and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung successfully exchanged visits late last year and early this year, leading China-South Korea relations into a new stage of improvement and development. China attaches great importance to Cho's visit and is willing to work with South Korea to implement the important consensus reached by the two leaders, exchange views on bilateral relations and issues of common concern, and advance the China-South Korea strategic cooperative partnership in a sustained, healthy and stable manner.
summary.zh_hans: 外交部宣布，经中韩双方商定，韩国外长赵显明日访华两日。发言人毛宁在例行记者会表示，国家主席习近平与韩国总统李在明在去年底、今年初成功实现互访，引领中韩关系进入改善发展的新阶段。中方很重视赵显的访问，愿意同韩方一起落实好两国元首的重要共识，就双边关系和共同关心的问题深入交换意见，推动中韩战略合作伙伴关系持续健康稳定发展。

title.zh_hant: 10月白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數跌至2.9%　蚊患進一步改善
title.en: October gravidtrap index for Aedes albopictus falls to 2.9% as mosquito problem eases further
title.zh_hans: 10月白纹伊蚊诱蚊器指数跌至2.9%　蚊患进一步改善

summary.zh_hant: 食環署公布，10月份全港白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數為2.9%，較9月份的5.2%進一步回落，反映食環署及相關部門加強防蚊滅蚊工作，整體蚊患情況進一步改善。10月份62個監察地區的分區誘蚊器指數全部低於20%的警戒水平；白紋伊蚊密度指數為1.1，顯示監察地區內白紋伊蚊成蚊數量並不多。食環署指出，鄰近地區仍錄得登革熱及基孔肯雅熱個案，輸入蚊傳疾病及二次傳播風險依然存在，署方會繼續在分區指數達10%或以上時開展強化控蚊工作，並提醒市民雖然已踏入秋季，但天氣仍然溫暖，仍有利蚊子滋生，應繼續做好防蚊滅蚊措施。
summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department announced that the monthly gravidtrap index for Aedes albopictus mosquitoes in October was 2.9 percent, down from 5.2 percent in September, reflecting intensified mosquito prevention and elimination efforts by the department and relevant departments and a further improvement in the overall mosquito situation. In October, all 62 survey areas recorded area gravidtrap indexes below the 20 percent alert level, and the monthly density index was 1.1, indicating adult Aedes albopictus were not abundant in the survey areas. The department noted that dengue fever and chikungunya fever cases were still recorded in neighbouring areas, so the risk of imported mosquito-borne diseases and secondary transmission remains; it will continue intensified mosquito control whenever an area index reaches 10 percent or above, and reminded the public that although autumn has arrived, the weather remains warm and still favours mosquito breeding, so prevention measures should continue.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署公布，10月份全港白纹伊蚊诱蚊器指数为2.9%，较9月份的5.2%进一步回落，反映食环署及相关部门加强防蚊灭蚊工作，整体蚊患情况进一步改善。10月份62个监察地区的分区诱蚊器指数全部低于20%的警戒水平；白纹伊蚊密度指数为1.1，显示监察地区内白纹伊蚊成蚊数量并不多。食环署指出，邻近地区仍录得登革热及基孔肯雅热个案，输入蚊传疾病及二次传播风险依然存在，署方会继续在分区指数达10%或以上时开展强化控蚊工作，并提醒市民虽然已踏入秋季，但天气仍然温暖，仍有利蚊子滋生，应继续做好防蚊灭蚊措施。

title.zh_hant: 鄺港傑供稱相信膠箱內有蔡天鳳屍首　猜測有部分已被肢解
title.en: Kwong Kong-kit testifies he believed box contained Choi Tin-fung's body; suspected part had been dismembered
title.zh_hans: 邝港杰供称相信胶箱内有蔡天凤尸首　猜测有部分已被肢解

summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案下午在高等法院續審，前大伯鄺港傑繼續作供。他表示，2023年2月21日晚上進入龍尾村村屋後，見到房間地上有一塊帆布，上面放有一個打開的帳蓬，內有透明膠箱，箱內有被鋪包裹的物體，其中一端有大量血液滲出，附近亦有一把早前曾在家中見過、用作鋸木的電鋸，刀片上有少量血跡。鄺港傑指出，當時見到的相信是父親日間用作放置蔡天鳳的膠箱和被鋪，相信箱內是蔡天鳳的屍首，又猜測屍體有某部分已被肢解。他又說，帳蓬是事發前一年夏天購買，一直放在自己荃灣寓所，從來無帶到村屋，也不知何時被人取走；父親其後將膠箱拖出客廳，指示他將帆布鋪好。
summary.en: The Choi Tin-fung case continued in the High Court this afternoon, with her former brother-in-law Kwong Kong-kit continuing his testimony. He said that on the evening of February 21, 2023, after entering the village house in Lung Mei Tsuen, he saw a tarpaulin on the floor of a room with an open tent on it containing a transparent plastic box, inside which was an object wrapped in a quilt, with a large amount of blood seeping from one end; nearby was an electric saw he had previously seen at home for cutting wood, with a small amount of blood on the blade. Kwong said he believed what he saw was the box and quilt his father had used during the day to hold Choi Tin-fung, and that the box contained her body, adding that he suspected part of the body had already been dismembered. He also said the tent had been bought the previous summer and kept at his Tsuen Wan flat, never taken to the village house, and he did not know when it had been removed; his father later dragged the box into the living room and told him to lay out the tarpaulin.
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案下午在高等法院续审，前大伯邝港杰继续作供。他表示，2023年2月21日晚上进入龙尾村村屋后，见到房间地上一块帆布，上面放有一个打开的帐篷，内有透明胶箱，箱内有被铺包裹的物体，其中一端有大量血液渗出，附近亦有一把早前曾在家中见过、用作锯木的电锯，刀片上有少量血迹。邝港杰指出，当时见到的相信是父亲日间用作放置蔡天凤的胶箱和被铺，相信箱内是蔡天凤的尸首，又猜测尸体有某部分已被肢解。他又说，帐篷是事发前一年夏天购买，一直放在自己荃湾寓所，从来无带到村屋，也不知何时被人取走；父亲其后将胶箱拖出客厅，指示他将帆布铺好。

title.zh_hant: 領展料本財年香港零售物業續租租金續跌中高單位數
title.en: Link REIT expects Hong Kong retail rental reversions to keep falling by mid-to-high single digits this financial year
title.zh_hans: 领展料本财年香港零售物业续租租金续跌中高单位数

summary.zh_hant: 領展截至9月底，香港零售物業續租租金下跌7.5%。香港租賃董事總經理霍業生表示，由於不少租約在2年前租金水平處於高位時簽訂，一般租賃期3年，估計仍需要大約一年，才能消化租金回落的影響，今個財政年度續租租金或會繼續錄得中高單位數下跌，整體收入仍面臨較大壓力。不過霍業生表示，旗下商場租金水平已回穩，北上消費趨勢下降，商戶生意額保持增長，認為業務有條件改善；零售市道面對電商挑戰，但本港亦吸引到大型電商擴展實體店，加上領展疫後不斷調整租戶組合，引入網購自提點、健身室、老人院及中醫等服務式租戶，繼續支持租賃需求。提到摩根大通2028年遷離九龍東「海濱匯」，霍業生說部分樓面已獲承租，現時出租率仍高達99.6%，有信心填補空缺。
summary.en: Link REIT's Hong Kong retail rental reversions fell 7.5 percent as of end-September. Hong Kong leasing managing director Fok Yip-sang said many leases were signed two years ago when rents were high and, with typical three-year terms, it will likely take about another year to absorb the rental decline, so reversions may keep falling by a mid-to-high single-digit percentage this financial year, with overall income still under considerable pressure. Fok added, however, that mall rents have stabilised, the trend of Hong Kong residents spending across the border has eased and tenants' sales continue to grow, so the business has room to improve; while retail faces challenges from e-commerce, large e-commerce players are also expanding physical stores in Hong Kong, and Link has kept adjusting its tenant mix since the pandemic, bringing in self-pickup points, gyms, elderly homes and Chinese medicine clinics to support leasing demand. On JPMorgan's departure from Harbour East in Kowloon East in 2028, Fok said some floors have already been leased and the occupancy rate remains as high as 99.6 percent, and he is confident the space will be filled.
summary.zh_hans: 领展截至9月底，香港零售物业续租租金下跌7.5%。香港租赁董事总经理霍业生表示，由于不少租约在2年前租金水平处于高位时签订，一般租赁期3年，估计仍需要大约一年，才能消化租金回落的影响，今个财政年度续租租金或会继续录得中高单位数下跌，整体收入仍面临较大压力。不过霍业生表示，旗下商场租金水平已回稳，北上消费趋势下降，商户生意额保持增长，认为业务有条件改善；零售市道面对电商挑战，但本港亦吸引到大型电商扩展实体店，加上领展疫后不断调整租户组合，引入网购自提点、健身室、老人院及中医等服务式租户，继续支持租赁需求。提到摩根大通2028年迁离九龙东「海滨汇」，霍业生说部分楼面已获承租，现时出租率仍高达99.6%，有信心填补空缺。

title.zh_hant: 本港約18宗輪候肺移植個案　醫生指合適捐贈肺部很少
title.en: About 18 lung transplant cases on Hong Kong waiting list; doctor says suitable donor lungs are rare
title.zh_hans: 本港约18宗轮候肺移植个案　医生指合适捐赠肺部很少

summary.zh_hant: 11月14日是器官捐贈日，截至今年9月，本港約有2631人正輪候器官移植，當中約18宗等候肺部移植。葛量洪醫院結核暨胸肺內科代理部門主管甄詩韻表示，患末期肺病的病人生活面臨挑戰，需常入醫院、依賴呼吸機，行動及生活受限制，死亡風險高，需要接受移植手術；而捐贈者肺部較其他器官更易受感染，合標準及可供移植的肺部很少，目前暫無透過跨境器官移植互助機制獲得的肺部捐贈個案。她呼籲市民主動登記器官捐贈及告知家人。早前接受肺部移植手術、現年66歲的男病人表示，確診肺纖維化10多年，術後持續鍛鍊超過1年，體能恢復到六至七成，感謝捐贈者令他有第二生命。
summary.en: November 14 is Organ Donation Day. As of September this year, about 2,631 people in Hong Kong were waiting for organ transplants, including about 18 cases awaiting lung transplants. Dr Yan Sze-wan, acting head of the tuberculosis and respiratory medicine department at Grantham Hospital, said patients with end-stage lung disease face major challenges, requiring frequent hospitalisation and ventilator support, with restricted movement and daily life and high mortality risk, and need transplant surgery; donor lungs are more prone to infection than other organs, so lungs meeting the standard and suitable for transplant are rare, and no lung donation has yet been obtained through the cross-boundary organ transplant mutual assistance mechanism. She urged the public to register as organ donors and tell their families. A 66-year-old man who received a lung transplant earlier said he had lived with pulmonary fibrosis for more than a decade and, after more than a year of exercise following surgery, has recovered 60 to 70 percent of his physical capacity, thanking the donor for giving him a second life.
summary.zh_hans: 11月14日是器官捐赠日，截至今年9月，本港约有2631人正轮候器官移植，当中约18宗等候肺部移植。葛量洪医院结核暨胸肺内科代理部门主管甄诗韵表示，患末期肺病的病人生活面临挑战，需常入医院、依赖呼吸机，行动及生活受限制，死亡风险高，需要接受移植手术；而捐赠者肺部较其他器官更易受感染，合标准及可供移植的肺部很少，目前暂无透过跨境器官移植互助机制获得的肺部捐赠个案。她呼吁市民主动登记器官捐赠及告知家人。早前接受肺部移植手术、现年66岁的男病人表示，确诊肺纤维化10多年，术后持续锻炼超过1年，体能恢复到六至七成，感谢捐赠者令他有第二生命。

title.zh_hant: 長和：零售業務獨立上市評估仍持續　未作任何決定
title.en: CK Hutchison: evaluation of standalone listing for retail business continues; no decision made
title.zh_hans: 长和：零售业务独立上市评估仍持续　未作任何决定

summary.zh_hant: 長和發出公告指，未有對任何零售業務獨立上市的交易作出決定，有關策略探索、評估及相關籌備工作仍然持續，目前並不確定是否進行有關交易。長和表示，知悉最近有報道指，集團暫停旗下零售業務建議獨立上市。公告指，集團不時接獲建議，並探索及評估可供考慮的機會，以提升股東長遠價值。
summary.en: CK Hutchison said in an announcement that it has made no decision on any transaction to list its retail business independently, and that related strategic exploration, evaluation and preparatory work continues, with no certainty at present whether any such transaction will proceed. The group said it noted recent reports that it had suspended a proposed standalone listing of its retail business. The announcement added that the group receives proposals from time to time and explores and evaluates opportunities under consideration to enhance long-term shareholder value.
summary.zh_hans: 长和发出公告指，未有对任何零售业务独立上市的交易作出决定，有关策略探索、评估及相关筹备工作仍然持续，目前并不确定是否进行有关交易。长和表示，知悉最近有报道指，集团暂停旗下零售业务建议独立上市。公告指，集团不时接获建议，并探索及评估可供考虑的机会，以提升股东长远价值。

title.zh_hant: 領展續售非核心資產　下半財年回購最多20億元基金單位
title.en: Link REIT to keep selling non-core assets; plans up to HK$2 billion in unit buybacks in second half
title.zh_hans: 领展续售非核心资产　下半财年回购最多20亿元基金单位

summary.zh_hant: 領展表示，上半財政年度動用出售新加坡Swing By@Thomson Plaza的資金，完成約15億元基金單位回購，計劃下半財政年度回購至少10億至20億元基金單位。領展已訂立協議，出售內地物流物業組合，包括大灣區兩項擁有75%權益的資產，以及長三角3項全資擁有的資產，初步作價11億元人民幣，較9月底物業估值折讓約3.4%，預計下季度完成。領展首席投資總裁宋俊彥表示，剝離內地物流資產有助將資源重新配置到亞洲商場項目，相關估值折讓對於出售非核心資產而言屬合理水平。他又提到，上月公布出售旺角「T.O.P」項目，隨著利率環境轉變，寫字樓市道開始吸引買家，領展希望透過出售非核心資產，專注投資亞洲零售資產。
summary.en: Link REIT said it used proceeds from the sale of Swing By@Thomson Plaza in Singapore to complete about HK$1.5 billion of unit buybacks in the first half of the financial year, and plans to buy back at least HK$1 billion to HK$2 billion of units in the second half. Link has agreed to sell its mainland logistics property portfolio, including two assets in the Greater Bay Area in which it holds 75 percent interests and three wholly owned assets in the Yangtze River Delta, for a preliminary price of RMB1.1 billion, about 3.4 percent below the September-end valuation, with completion expected next quarter. Chief investment officer Song Junyan said divesting mainland logistics assets will help redeploy resources into Asian retail projects and that the valuation discount is reasonable for non-core asset sales. He added that last month's announced sale of the T.O.P project in Mong Kok came as changing interest rates began attracting buyers to the office market, and Link hopes to focus on Asian retail assets by selling non-core properties.
summary.zh_hans: 领展表示，上半财政年度动用出售新加坡Swing By@Thomson Plaza的资金，完成约15亿元基金单位回购，计划下半财政年度回购至少10亿至20亿元基金单位。领展已订立协议，出售内地物流物业组合，包括大湾区两项拥有75%权益的资产，以及长三角3项全资拥有的资产，初步作价11亿元人民币，较9月底物业估值折让约3.4%，预计下季度完成。领展首席投资总裁宋俊彦表示，剥离内地物流资产有助将资源重新配置到亚洲商场项目，相关估值折让对于出售非核心资产而言属合理水平。他又提到，上月公布出售旺角「T.O.P」项目，随着利率环境转变，写字楼市道开始吸引买家，领展希望透过出售非核心资产，专注投资亚洲零售资产。

title.zh_hant: 鄺港傑稱事發當天處於恐慌　弟弟離開時狀態一片空白
title.en: Kwong Kong-kit says he was in a panic on the day; brother left in a daze
title.zh_hans: 邝港杰称事发当天处于恐慌　弟弟离开时状态一片空白

summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案在高等法院續審，前大伯鄺港傑繼續作供。他說，事發當日下午3時許，正在龍尾村村屋外清理車廂期間，父親鄺球站在屋內客廳位置思考，弟弟鄺港智則手持一個白色膠袋，輕輕說了句「我走了」便離開，沒有交代去向。鄺港傑認為，弟弟當時狀態一片空白，不知自己在做甚麼，他自己亦處於恐慌之中，沒有與弟弟溝通。他之後走回七人車上冷靜自己，形容過去1小時發生很多事，心情複雜，回想「點解會搞成咁」，未見過弟弟這個狀態，對弟弟感到陌生和不解。鄺港傑又說，離開村屋後將七人車駛回市區，泊車後打開乘客位車門，發現儲物格內有蔡天鳳的手提電話，當時很驚慌，因此將電話關機，並在洗手間洗臉期間順道將電話丟棄。被問到對於蔡天鳳離世有何感受，他說一直欺騙自己事情無發生過，直至被拘捕抵達警署，獲警方告知在村屋尋獲蔡天鳳的殘肢，才回復理智，感覺開始湧現並一直哭泣。
summary.en: The Choi Tin-fung case continued in the High Court, with her former brother-in-law Kwong Kong-kit continuing his testimony. He said that at about 3pm on the day, while cleaning the car outside the village house in Lung Mei Tsuen, his father Kwong Kau stood thinking in the living room while his younger brother Kwong Kong-chi, holding a white plastic bag, quietly said 'I'm leaving' and walked off without saying where he was going. Kwong said his brother seemed in a daze, not knowing what he was doing, and he himself was in a panic and did not speak to him. He then returned to the seven-seater to calm himself, saying a great deal had happened in the past hour and his feelings were complicated as he wondered how things had come to this, having never seen his brother in such a state and finding him unfamiliar and incomprehensible. Kwong added that after leaving the village house he drove back to the city and, on opening the passenger door after parking, found Choi Tin-fung's mobile phone in the storage compartment; panicking, he switched it off and discarded it while washing his face in a restroom. Asked how he felt about Choi's death, he said he had kept deceiving himself that nothing had happened until, after his arrest at the police station, officers told him Choi's remains had been found in the village house, at which point he regained his senses and began to cry.
